title: Superintendent
description:
*Please Note: Uprite Construction is not accepting resumes from third-party agencies for this position. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Uprite Construction's property, and no fees will be paid for unsolicited referrals.*

The Role

As a Superintendent, you will be the on site leader ensuring that projects are built safely, on schedule, and to the highest quality standards. We are looking for someone with deep experience in tilt up construction who can manage crews, coordinate subcontractors, and work closely with our project managers to keep everything moving forward.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead day to day field operations for assigned project(s)

  • Schedule, direct, and coordinate subcontractors and field teams

  • Oversee all aspects of tilt up construction including layout, panel erection, bracing, and sequencing

  • Monitor quality control and ensure compliance with drawings, specifications, and safety standards

  • Conduct daily huddles, toolbox talks, and weekly safety meetings

  • Maintain project schedule and communicate progress and challenges to the project manager

  • Manage inspections and resolve field issues as they arise

  • Promote a culture of safety and teamwork on site

  • Maintain accurate daily reports, photos, and site documentation

What You Bring

  • Proven experience as a Superintendent on commercial or industrial projects, with a strong focus on tilt up concrete

  • Thorough knowledge of tilt up panel construction methods, scheduling, and best practices

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate crews and foster collaboration

  • Excellent communication and problem solving skills

  • OSHA 30 certification preferred

  • Proficiency with construction technology (Procore, MS Project, or similar)

  • A commitment to quality, safety, and doing the job right the first time

About Us

Uprite Construction was established in 1991 as a multi-service construction company specializing in project site development, ground-up, new construction, renovations, and tenant improvements for the commercial and industrial sectors. Check us out at upritecomgmt.com!

We appreciate your interest in employment with Uprite Construction. Uprite Construction is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity, and will not discriminate against an applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, age, physical or mental disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, or any other legally-recognized protected basis under federal, state, or local law. Applicants with disabilities who need assistance with the application process may be entitled to a reasonable accommodation in accordance with applicable law.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
Are you ready to solve complex data challenges and build a single source of truth for our entire company? As our Senior Analytics Engineer, you'll own our central data foundation, turning high-level business goals into a reliable data foundation for analytics, modeling and AI use cases.

Your role

As a Senior Analytics Engineer, you are the architect and owner of our central data foundation, working alongside a diverse team of analytics engineers, data engineers, data analysts, and data scientists. Right now, data is scattered across multiple systems. Your mission? Eliminate "multiple truths" once and for all and establish a single source of truth across the company.

You won't just build reliable data models for business analysts and finance teams; you'll also design the architecture powering advanced AI applications, like our agentic LLM tool. Serving as the primary technical bridge between analysts, data scientists, and platform engineers, you won't wait for explicit daily instructions. You take high-level business goals, ask the right probing questions, and independently translate them into robust, production-ready solutions. Got a good idea or a smarter solution? At BridgeFund, you can take it from idea to production in no time. That speed of execution is one of the best parts of working in our data team.

Your responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain complex, production-grade data models in Databricks (Gold layer) focused on performance, reliability, and reusability.

  • Lead requirements sessions with business stakeholders (Finance, Product), translate ambiguous needs, and act as the primary liaison to Platform and AI engineering teams.

  • Solve live and historical data integration challenges to eliminate conflicting metrics across systems.

  • Model data from CDC sources to capture full audit histories and change records.

  • Build automated quality checks, monitoring dashboards, and alerting systems, implement consistent naming conventions, and tag models in Unity Catalog.

  • Play a key role in defining uniform, company-wide metrics (a layer on top of our data registries) and actively align definitions and interpretations across the business, spotting and resolving inconsistencies like conflicting DPD definitions.

  • Champion software engineering best practices, including version control, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

What you bring

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering.

  • Production-level experience with SQL, Python, and CI/CD pipelines. Working experience with Databricks (or PySpark) is a plus.

  • Experience with frameworks like dbt, Kimball or Databricks to structure data models.

  • You thrive on self-leadership. You don't need detailed hand-holding to define required steps and execute.

  • You understand how technical definitions (like principal balances or DPD) affect lending decisions and communicate fluently with non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience in fast-paced scale-up environments where roles have broad scope and require working across domain boundaries.

Don't tick every box? Tell us anyway- we hire for trajectory and judgement, not a checklist. That's usually how the best engineers start here.

Who we are

While small businesses drive the economy, when it comes to financing, traditional systems still move at the speed of paper. We founded BridgeFund in 2018 to change that. We've stripped away the bureaucracy: an entrepreneur applies in just five minutes, and our advanced technology processes the data quickly and efficiently. By combining cutting-edge automation with real human logic, we make financing decisions that are both fast and fair. We grew 55% last year and have proudly fast-tracked over €700 million in loans to entrepreneurs. Our next goal? To scale our data capabilities by making our platform even sharper, ensuring support for the next generation of entrepreneurs

What we offer

A competitive salary between €5,933 and €6,504 based on 40 hours per week. Growth is intentional here. We use an internal competency framework to help you track your progress and continuously evolve in your role.

  • A hybrid model, requiring three days per week in our office.

  • 6% pension via ASR Doen Pensioen

  • 25 paid vacation days and 8% holiday allowance

  • Two weeks per year of remote work from abroad

  • Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer (even if you cycle)

  • €40 Alleo budget per month for things like TrainMore, Uber, or a day out

  • BridgeFund Academy for personal growth, learning, and coaching

  • Annual Learning & Development budget of €1,500 for your professional growth

  • Modern workspace with a MacBook, open areas, quiet zones, and zero ceiling tiles

  • Bridge Day: one extra day off for something that matters to you

  • Company boat The Royal Ted for team events or private use

  • Sports activities such as boxing classes and a running club

  • 50% paid lunches

  • Free snacks: healthy and not-so-healthy

  • Friday drinks, quarterly parties, and team outings

  • BridgeFun(d) bar with DJ booth, stage, and karaoke

Curious?

Good. That is usually how the best engineers start here at BridgeFund. Apply directly or reach out to Anna-Maria at recruitment@bridgefund.nl. We would love to hear what you would build next.

title: Assistente de Padaria
description:
O Assistente de Padaria é responsável por apoiar o processo produtivo da padaria, incluindo preparo, modelagem, forneamento e finalização dos produtos, garantindo qualidade, frescor, organização e atendimento aos padrões de higiene e segurança alimentar.


A Bemol é uma empresa de prestação de serviços e comercialização de produtos no varejo, que tem como principal objetivo a busca da satisfação de nossos Clientes, antes, durante e após o processo de vendas, observando o processo de melhoria contínua, legislação externa aplicável, princípios e valores culturais da organização, sendo esses princípios Integridade, Respeito, Economia, Energia e Melhoria Continua.

No time Bemol, você poderá encantar o cliente realizando as atividades descritas abaixo:


  • Auxiliar na produção de pães, bolos, doces e demais itens preparados na padaria, conforme receitas e orientações do padeiro.
  • Preparar, fatiar, embalar e etiquetar produtos conforme padrões internos.
  • Organizar e repor produtos na área de vendas, garantindo boa apresentação e frescor.
  • Auxiliar no controle de validade, qualidade e armazenamento adequado dos itens.
  • Manter o ambiente limpo e higienizado, seguindo normas de segurança alimentar (BPF – Boas Práticas de Fabricação).
  • Atender clientes quando necessário, oferecendo suporte e orientações sobre os produtos.
  • Operar equipamentos básicos da área (fatiadores, balanças, fornos, etc.), seguindo regras de segurança.
  • Apoiar o inventário do setor e o controle de estoque de insumos.
  • Informar ao superior imediato sobre necessidades de reposição, avarias ou irregularidades observadas.
  • Realizar a limpeza e higienização completa dos fornos, bancadas, utensílios e demais equipamentos utilizados na produção, garantindo conformidade com as normas de segurança alimentar e boas práticas de manipulação.


É importante que você tenha!


Ensino médio completo.

Cursos ou treinamentos em manipulação de alimentos e atendimento ao cliente serão diferenciais.

Experiência prévia em padaria, confeitaria, produção de alimentos ou atendimento no varejo.


Conhecimentos Desejáveis


  • Noções de higiene e manipulação de alimentos.
  • Boas práticas de fabricação (BPF).
  • Organização e atendimento ao cliente.

Competências Comportamentais


  • Organização
  • Agilidade
  • Atenção aos detalhes
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Proatividade
  • Foco no cliente
  • Responsabilidade

Horário: Disponibilidade de horário para trabalhar sábados, domingos e feriados.

Etapas:


  • Inscrição;
  • Avaliações;
  • Teste Psicológico;
  • Dinâmica de Grupo;
  • Entrevista.


Documentos Obrigatórios:


  • Carteira de Identidade;
  • CPF;
  • Comprovante de Residência;
  • Título de Eleitor;
  • Escolaridade;
  • Comprovante de PIS/Pasep;
  • Registro Administrativo de Nascimento de Indígena (RANI) - Se aplicável;
  • Dados Bancários;
  • Certificado de Reservista.


Documentos Opcionais:


  • Certidão de Casamento;
  • Certidão de Nascimento (Dependente);
  • Cartão Nacional de Saúde - CNS (Dependente);
  • Comprovante de Vacinação (Dependente).


Nós da Bemol, respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valorização das diferenças (ex: Gênero, Religião, PCD, LGBTQ+, Raça e Etnia). Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso.

title: Senior Consultant
description:
Senior Consultant



Freedman HealthCare LLC (FHC) is a growing Massachusetts-based consulting firm with a national footprint. We have helped more than 30 states use data and policy to improve healthcare quality, affordability and equity. We aim to be the partner of choice for policymakers and changemakers who use data to transform healthcare and promote health, well-being, and justice. Freedman HealthCare is an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and growing consultancy with a culture of teamwork, open communication, and meeting exacting standards.



Job Summary:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced individual to join our team as a Senior Consultant, whose projects will include our work helping states implement federal health programs such as the Rural Health Transformation Program. The Senior Consultant is a recognized national expert in state health program management who will serve as the FHC lead on cutting edge projects which improve health outcomes and optimize healthcare delivery. Reporting to the Vice President, you will mentor and supervise 2-4 Project Managers and work closely with our clients in state governments and non-profits to design and efficiently implement initiatives to the highest quality standards. Your expertise in health policy and program design and management combined with your deep understanding of national trends will be instrumental in delivering impactful solutions and expanding Freedman HealthCare’s professional service offerings.



Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Serve as trusted advisor to State-agency clients and others that work in the healthcare industry to understand their specific challenges and goals and propose appropriate and creative methodologies and approaches.
  • Serve as lead and accountable party on cutting edge health data projects, with responsibility for project design and execution of all client deliverables, including content, quality, and accuracy.
  • Delegate work to, and oversee, cross-functional project teams – including data engineers, project managers, and subject matter experts – to achieve project goals and deliverables on time and on budget.
  • Scope and draft written deliverables, organizing key information in a clear and impactful manner.
  • Supervise 2-4 Project Managers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support, including day-to-day supervision and performance review.
  • Lead stakeholder meetings
  • Develop and deliver national presentations.
  • Identify opportunities to expand Freedman HealthCare’s professional service offerings, including guidance on entering new markets and other business development opportunities
  • Lead business development activities, including serving as lead writer on RFP’s and other bid proposals.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Recognized national expert in subject matter aligned with FHC’s business priorities
  • Proven success in business development
  • Substantial experience in successfully leading and managing heath data projects
  • Experience in project design and evaluation, including experience in defining project roles and delegating tasks appropriately
  • Experience serving as a supervisor and mentor
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to multi-task and work under deadlines.
  • Demonstrable writing and presentation skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to derive insights from complex datasets and identify trends and key takeaways in a clear manner
  • Self-motivation and time management skills, with the ability to thrive in a remote work environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Attentiveness to evolving client needs
  • Strategic mindset, with the ability to align work and project approaches with FHC’s business objectives
  • Creative problem-solving skills
  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite, including Microsoft Project, Excel and PowerPoint



Education and Experience Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • Advance degree (Master’s of Public Health or similar) preferred
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience leading and managing project teams in the health data or health policy fields
  • Experience as a direct supervisor

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer



Note:

  • The job description provided above is a general outline and may be subject to modifications based on specific organizational requirements.

Freedman HealthCare, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We strongly encourage applications and inquiries from women, LGBTQIA+ identified persons, Black, Indigenous, People of Color, people with disabilities, and others from historically underrepresented communities. We believe that embracing diversity in our workplace is essential to achieving the best results for our clients and as an organization.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Overview

We are seeking a full-time Senior Software Engineer at Garmin's Cary, North Carolina location. In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical leadership and project planning for software development for products, applications, or systems new to Garmin as an individual contributor. You will develop and maintain production embedded software and automated security test capabilities, review product designs and vulnerabilities, and support cybersecurity regulatory compliance efforts, including the European Union Cyber Resilience Act and similar initiatives. A substantial portion of this role will remain focused on hands‑on software development.

This position is well-suited to an experienced embedded software engineer with a strong interest in product security who wants to expand their responsibilities into security analysis, defensive testing, risk assessment, and cybersecurity regulatory compliance. Prior formal cybersecurity compliance experience is beneficial but not required.

Essential Functions

  • Serves in a leadership capacity as an individual contributor, developing embedded software in C, C++, Python, Assembly language, or other selected languages for new and existing products, systems, and engineering tools
  • May serve as a Lead Software Engineer for complex projects and reviews software architectures, modules, and systems supporting new technology or improving the capability, performance, reliability, or security of existing functionality
  • Provides technical ownership for selected security‑critical software components, potentially including services associated with hardware roots of trust, secure elements, cryptographic functions, key management, or Trusted Execution Environments
  • Decomposes functional, security, and regulatory requirements into well‑defined engineering tasks and develops appropriate software solutions based on product architecture, operating environment, and identified risks
  • Performs peer technical assessments and reviews embedded software and system designs for security weaknesses, regulatory concerns, appropriate use of security controls, and sound engineering practices.
  • Analyzes product attack surfaces, vulnerabilities, trust boundaries, and potential misuse to determine realistic impact and recommend appropriate remediation, mitigation, or risk treatment.
  • Develops and maintains automated security, robustness, penetration, and fuzzing test capabilities for Marine products within laboratory and continuous-testing environments.
  • Assists with cybersecurity compliance analysis, risk assessments, technical documentation, and evidence development for major regulatory initiatives such as the European Union Cyber Resilience Act
  • Participates in project leadership and program planning, including evaluating technical feasibility, identifying risk, setting schedules, and providing input to product development and cybersecurity plans
  • Communicates technical security and compliance conclusions across engineering and business organizations and constructively challenges designs, assumptions, or proposed risk decisions when the available evidence does not support them
  • Plans and manages complex technical assignments with a high degree of independence while balancing software development, analysis, documentation, and compliance deliverables
  • Mentors less‑experienced engineers, contributes to advanced technical research, and recommends improvements to engineering and product‑security processes

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Math, Physics or related field AND a minimum of 5 years relevant experience OR an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Excellent academics (cumulative GPA greater than or equal to 3.0 as a general rule)
  • Demonstrated proficiency with designing well architectured software systems and modules that support new technology or improve capability/performance of existing functionality
  • Demonstrated competence with researching fundamental problems and implementing appropriate algorithmic solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to serve as a lead software engineer for a complex software project
  • Ability to decompose functional requirements into well‑defined tasks while balancing quality, quantity, and complexity in work output
  • Demonstrated capability to offer peer technical assessments in areas of expertise, new technologies and software designs
  • Mastered proficiency in writing software in C, C++, C# or Java and relevant experience and/or training in data structures or object‑oriented design methodology
  • Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Must be positive, detail oriented, organized, team oriented and a driven problem solver, multi‑tasker, and self‑starter with the ability to prioritize and lead in a fast paced, deadline‑driven environment

Desired Qualifications

  • Outstanding academics (cumulative GPA greater than or equal to 3.5)
  • Experience developing security‑critical embedded software, privileged system services, and software associated with secure elements, hardware roots of trust, cryptographic services, key management, secure boot, secure storage, or Trusted Execution Environments
  • Experience with embedded Linux security mechanisms, inter‑process communication, privilege separation, networking protocols, and hardware‑access control
  • Experience performing security design reviews, threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, and product‑security risk assessments
  • Experience developing automated security, adversarial, protocol‑robustness, penetration, and fuzzing tests for embedded and network‑connected products
  • Experience with Python for test automation, analysis tools, and engineering infrastructure
  • Familiarity with software composition analysis, software bills of materials, open‑source vulnerability management, and cybersecurity regulations and standards applicable to connected products
  • Experience working across multiple engineering organizations and within a regulated, safety‑related, high‑reliability, and process‑disciplined product environment.

Garmin International is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.

This position is eligible for Garmin's benefit program. Details can be found here: Garmin Benefits

title: Customer Team Member
description:
Customer Team Member
Location: 72 Lower Road , River, CT17 0RD
Pay: £13.04 per hour
Contract: 16 hours per week + regular overtime, permanent contract, part time
Working pattern: Closing shifts from mid-afternoon through to late evening and close, with flexible availability across the week to include at least 1 weekend shift. Either Friday after 6pm, any shift on Saturday, or Sunday. We’re happy to discuss your availability further at interview.
Full, paid training provided
Apply easily from your mobile device by completing our assessments (no CV needed!)

You must be aged 18 or over to apply for this role as it may involve either, working before 6am or after 10pm, or some other business-related needs.

We’re looking for Customer Team Members to join our team at Co-op, join us and play a key role in delivering friendly, helpful service in your local Co-op store.

As a Customer Team Member, you’ll work as part of a friendly team in a fast-moving Co-op store, helping deliver essential services to your community every day. Depending on your store, this could involve working in our post office, or bakery, or helping with online services by picking and packing orders for home delivery. Whatever the day brings, you'll play a key role in making life easier for our customers.

Why this job matters:
You’ll help keep our shelves stocked and support sales, making sure customers can find what they need. You’ll be a familiar face in the community, getting to know your customers and helping us stay connected with local and national charities. Plus, you’ll promote Co-op membership, helping more customers enjoy the benefits of our unique business.

What you'll do:
  • Support the day-to-day running of the store by delivering friendly and thoughtful service, helping to put things right when needed
  • Work with your team to keep the store running smoothly
  • Work hands-on on the shop floor and tills, and contribute to daily operations to create a great shopping experience
  • Help maintain store performance by keeping shelves stocked and checking prices, dates, and stock accuracy
  • Make sure the store safe and legal – keep the shelves stocked and make sure prices, dates, and temperatures are all as they should be
  • Promote Co-op Membership and support your local community
What you'll bring:
  • A genuine passion for helping people and delivering great customer service
  • The ability to work flexibly across a number of shifts and as part of a team
  • An interest in retail and working in a busy store environment (experience not essential)
Why Co-op?
At Co-op, we're owned by our members. And because we're owned by you, we can do right by you. So, when you join us, you're not just taking a job, you're joining a movement. We're an organisation that puts people and communities first, and we're powered by purpose. We want this to be a place where you can thrive, so you'll also receive:
  • Full training and career development resources
  • 30% discount on all Co-op products in-store
  • Flexible access to your pay as you earn it
  • A pension scheme with up to 10% employer contributions
  • 31 days of holiday (including bank holidays, pro rata for part time colleagues)
  • 24/7 access to GP appointments, and colleague support programme
  • Cycle-to-work scheme
  • Market-leading policies to help you through life's big moments
A place you'll belong:
We’re building diverse and inclusive teams that reflect the communities we serve. We welcome applications from everyone and are committed to creating a workplace where colleagues can feel like they belong, supported by our inclusive policies and the ways we work.
We’re proud to be part of the Disability Confident scheme and offer interviews to disabled candidates who meet the minimum criteria for a job. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, we’ll support you.
Learn more about our recruitment process at jobs.coop.co.uk/apply-process and our inclusion commitments at jobs.coop.co.uk/diversity-inclusion
As part of the application process for this job, you’ll need to complete two online assessments. It will take 15- 20 minutes to complete these tests.
We reserve the right to remove a vacancy before the scheduled closing date.

title: Wealth Management Solutions - Product Delivery, Vice President
description:
The Annuity and Insurance Product Delivery & Platform Strategy Team drives projects/programs that focus on driving strategic and continuous improvement initiatives supporting our Annuity and Insurance product organization across JPM Wealth Management. Responsibilities include analyzing business and operational processes to identify and recommend product & platform innovation, efficiencies, and applicability initiatives to drive business results. As part of the team, this role will partner with business leadership, key business stakeholders, and our third-party U.S. based insurance carriers and vendors to define, development and manage successful implementation. The role will have a strong focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI) initiatives and serve as a central point of accountability to translate the business AI vision into an executable roadmap—defining program scope, delivery operating model, milestones, resourcing, and dependency management across multiple concurrent initiatives.

The ideal candidate should have proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, think strategically, influence without authority, be a self-starter, and able to lead complex projects with a broad scope of stakeholders. The candidate will manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, encourage a strong collaborative environment, and drive projects end-to-end to completion. The ability to work across business functions (including sales, operations, technology, marketing, legal, risk, compliance) is critical to the role. The candidate will be familiar with the financial services industry, with an understanding of Life Insurance & Annuities.

Job Responsibilities

  • Support Product Delivery across Annuities & Insurance products overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of product delivery from epic creation, story writing, progress reports, overseeing UAT and reporting off and signing off on readiness.

  • Lead AI initiative delivery (end-to-end): Own intake, scoping, roadmap, and execution for AI projects supporting the Annuity & Life insurance business (e.g., new AI-enabled tools, process automation, decision-support), aligning stakeholders on objectives, timelines, and measurable outcomes

  • Translate business needs into executable plans: Partner with product, technology, data, risk/compliance, and operations and other stakeholders to convert use cases into clear requirements, delivery milestones, dependency plans, and success metrics (e.g., adoption, cycle-time reduction, quality/accuracy improvements).

  • Drive operational excellence with AI-enabled PM practices: Identify and pilot AI capabilities that improve project management efficiency (e.g., status automation, risk/issue prediction, documentation support), and standardize governance, reporting, and change management to scale proven approaches across the portfolio.

  • Develop and manage initiatives while balancing stakeholder, risk and business impacts.

  • Leverage data to understand user behavior, drive decision making, and business goals for growth and efficiency.

  • Partner with stakeholders to define functional requirements and translating these requirements into Epics, and stories for technology to deliver solutions

  • Oversee and coordinate all user acceptance testing for projects and provide reports of testing results, readiness to go/live and facilitation of go/no go decisions.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Experience: 8–12+ years in project/program management with multi-workstream delivery ownership (technology, data, or digital transformation); experience operating at VP level, experience in financial services, with preferred subject matter expertise in annuities and/or insurance.

  • AI / analytics delivery exposure: Direct experience delivering AI/ML, advanced analytics, automation, or GenAI-enabled capabilities (doesn’t need to be hands-on model building, but must understand the lifecycle and delivery implications)

  • Strategy-to-execution translation: Convert an AI strategy into a sequenced roadmap with clear milestones, dependencies, resourcing, and benefits tracking.

  • Prioritization and decision facilitation: Run an objective prioritization process (value, complexity, data readiness, operational readiness, risk) and drive timely decisions with senior leaders.

  • End-to-end delivery management: Own delivery from intake and requirements through build, testing, release, adoption, and post-launch measurement (including hyper care where needed).

title: Java Developer | Application Modernization & Azure Cloud Migration
description:

title: Director of Pre-College Pathways
description:
The University of Notre Dame, the leading Catholic global research University, offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional students the opportunity to pursue their academic endeavors in a scholarly community that is enriched by Catholic intellectual and cultural traditions. As the University advances the vision outlined in Notre Dame 2033: A Strategic Framework, the Undergraduate Enrollment team is seeking an innovative, mission-oriented, and strategic leader for the position of Director of Pre-College Pathways.

The Undergraduate Enrollment Division works to open doors to a Notre Dame education, empowering students to pursue, discover, and share knowledge, truth, and faith as a powerful means for good. The division is committed to creating socioeconomic mobility for students from all pathways, increasing the global Catholic community on its campus, and ensuring that the Notre Dame undergraduate student body represents the gifts and experiences of the full human family.

Reporting to the Executive Director for Enrollment Management, this pivotal leadership role is responsible for architecting the strategic vision and providing direct leadership and oversight for two vital institutional assets: the Office of Pre-College Programs and the Notre Dame TRIO Programs.

The Office of Pre-College Programs delivers highly selective, rigorous academic and residential experiences for high-achieving high school students from across the globe, inviting them to engage with Notre Dame’s world-class faculty and distinctive Catholic mission. Complementing this global outreach, the Notre Dame TRIO Programs encompass federally funded initiatives (such as Upward Bound and Talent Search) deeply rooted in the local community, providing critical college-access resources, mentorship, and advocacy for first-generation and low-income students. Together under the Director's leadership, these departments will create a cohesive and powerful ecosystem that expands educational opportunity, drives socioeconomic mobility, and cultivates the next generation of mission-aligned leaders.

The successful candidate will be a visionary strategist, an exceptional communicator, and a master relationship-builder. They will be tasked with coordinating a comprehensive pathways strategy that ensures talented and mission-aligned pre-college and community students are inspired by, prepared for, and connected to higher education opportunities. By leveraging collaborative partnerships across the division, campus, and broader community, this leader will ensure a seamless and transformative journey from early academic outreach to enrollment readiness.

Specific responsibilities of the position include the following:

  • Strategic Pathway Management: Develop and coordinate a comprehensive strategic vision for the University's pre-college and access pathways, ensuring programs align with the University's mission and broader enrollment goals.
  • Divisional Leadership: Provide direct supervision, mentorship, and strategic direction to the Pre-College Programs team and the TRIO Programs team, ensuring their efforts are integrated, compliant, and mission-aligned.
  • Access and Outreach Strategy: Oversee the design and delivery of high-impact pre-college academic experiences and federally funded TRIO initiatives that articulate the value of higher education to both global and local student populations.
  • Programmatic Engagement: Lead the execution of world-class on-campus residential, virtual, and community-based initiatives that foster a deep sense of belonging, academic capability, and community for participating students.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Partner closely with Undergraduate Admissions and enrollment leadership to align early talent identification with future recruitment pipelines, utilizing data-informed insights to optimize program efficacy.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with senior leadership, faculty across academic colleges and schools, local school districts, and community stakeholders to deliver a compelling experience for all students.
  • Innovation and Compliance: Stay abreast of federal regulations, youth protection guidelines, best practices, and emerging trends in college access and pre-college programming to ensure Notre Dame remains a leader in the field.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years of experience in higher education or a similar industry (specifically within college access, pre-college, or student success programming)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s or Doctoral degree
  • Exceptional communication (written and oral), presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively influence and inspire multiple stakeholders.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, with proven experience in developing and implementing data-driven strategies that have resulted in measurable improvements.
  • A strong understanding of college readiness frameworks, federal TRIO grant regulations, and enrollment management principles within a highly selective university environment.
  • Experience leading student access, youth programming, or academic-enrichment teams in a fast-paced, mission-driven organization.

Hiring Pay Range: Commensurate with experience

title: Director of Financial Planning & Analytics (SLC)
description:
Join a team that’s transforming mental healthcare. Founded by psychiatrists, Headlight is more than a company: it’s a movement. A movement that exists on the front lines of the mental health crisis, transforming the way people access care and the way clinicians deliver it. In order to help people in their time of need and ensure that every person who comes to us has options, we are transparent about our capabilities, treatments, and coverage, we champion innovation, and we leverage our rich data to continuously implement better ways of delivering care. Our mission is simple but powerful: Improving lives, one session at a time.

Our highly skilled and principled clinical team enjoys autonomy and institutional support so they can put their focus where it should be: on improving patient outcomes. Our clinicians want to do more than help individual clients, so they work to affect the system as a whole, elevating standards of care so that their efforts reverberate far beyond what they could do in private practice.

As the most trusted behavioral health partner in the Western U.S., we’ve established deep relationships that give us unparalleled access, interoperability, and first-priority referrals. This exclusivity, combined with our best-in-class coordinated care and feedback loops, results in superior outcomes and cost savings.

Our services are convenient, accessible, and expert, combining personalized client engagement with advanced technology to enhance, not replace, human connection. Indeed, we hold that human-to-human relationships are indispensable, so from the match to the session to the time between sessions, we provide whole person care so nobody falls through the cracks and there is a brighter path forward for all.

We're looking for a Director of Financial Planning & Analytics to own the systems, models, and processes that power financial decision-making at Headlight Health. Reporting to the CFO, you'll own the forecasting and analytics function that drives revenue visibility, budgeting, and long-range planning across a growing multi-site behavioral health organization.This role is ideally hybrid out of our Salt Lake City office, though we're open to remote candidates who bring the right experience and working style.

For local applicants to Salt Lake City this will be a hybrid schedule. Remote applicants not local to SLC apply here.

This is not a traditional FP&A role, and it is not a people management role. You'll operate as a senior individual contributor owning the analytical infrastructure — developing scalable models and planning frameworks that help leadership understand where the business is going, not just where it's been. You'll work at the intersection of finance, billing operations, and data, building the forecasting capabilities that a scaling healthcare company needs.Success in this role depends on your ability to continuously identify what's preventing our financial picture from being accurate, timely, and actionable. Sometimes that means improving a model. More often, it means uncovering gaps in upstream data quality, billing processes, or systems — and driving cross-functional solutions to fix them. We're looking for someone who understands how finance, operations, and data come together in a healthcare environment, and who has built planning capabilities from the ground up.

This is a role where the work evolves constantly. We're still building a lot of our processes, and the person in this seat will have real influence over how they take shape. If you want a defined playbook to execute, this probably isn't the right fit. If you want to understand a complex system and help make it better, we'd love to talk.

Our Pillars

  • Make things easier.
  • Forge genuine connections.
  • Elevate the standard.

    • Roles and Responsiblities

  • Own the company's forecasting methodology across revenue, reimbursement, and long-range planning — partnering closely with our Sales & Operations Planning function on provider productivity.
  • Improve, build, and evolve driver-based financial models that support executive decision-making, budgeting, scenario analysis, and growth planning.
  • Continuously identify gaps in data, systems, and billing processes that limit forecasting accuracy or scalability, and drive cross-functional efforts to resolve them.
  • Influence stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Billing, and Clinical to implement process improvements, strengthen data quality, and improve the inputs that power planning.
  • Lead the evolution of financial reporting from manual, spreadsheet-driven workflows toward scalable, repeatable processes and modern planning tools.
  • Partner with billing and operations teams to operationalize financial models and build reporting infrastructure that reflects how the business actually works.
  • Establish governance, documentation, and feedback loops that measure forecast performance, identify variance root causes, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Support investor reporting, board materials, and fundraising with clear, well-supported financial narratives.
  • Own the annual budget, forecast, and long-range planning cycle end-to-end.

    • Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in financial planning, strategic finance, or financial analytics — ideally in healthcare, MSO, or a complex multi-site services environment.
  • Deep expertise building forecasting models for revenue, operating expenses, and long-range planning.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare revenue cycle economics — reimbursement, payer contracts, and AR dynamics. Familiarity with provider productivity metrics is a plus; you'll partner with our S&OP function rather than own that domain.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify root causes behind forecasting or planning challenges and drive improvements to business processes, systems, or data quality.
  • Proven success influencing cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority to implement operational or analytical change.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency; SQL experience preferred or strong willingness to learn.
  • Experience with modern planning or BI tools (Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Pigment, Power BI, Tableau, or similar) preferred.
  • Self-directed and comfortable operating with ambiguity in a fast-moving environment.
  • For local applicants to Salt Lake City this will be a hybrid schedule. Remote applicants not local to SLC apply here.

    • What Success Looks Like

  • Forecast accuracy improves because you've identified and resolved underlying data, process, and systems gaps — not just refined spreadsheet formulas.
  • Revenue and reimbursement forecasts become trusted inputs for executive and board decision-making because assumptions are transparent and business inputs are reliable.
  • Finance evolves from a reactive reporting function to a proactive planning capability, with scalable models and repeatable workflows.
  • Cross-functional teams — billing, operations, clinical — adopt new processes that improve the quality and timeliness of financial inputs.
  • Leadership has a clear, reliable picture of where the business is going, with the scenario analysis and risk visibility to make confident decisions.
  • You operate as a force multiplier — a senior individual contributor who drives the quality of financial thinking across the organization who helps build the finance team out over time.

    • Benefits

  • W2 role with competitive compensation
  • Medical, Dental and Vision on the first of the month after employment
  • Paid Vacation, Sick, and Holiday time
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) provides confidential counseling services, resources, and support to help you navigate personal or professional challenges.
  • 401(k) plan with company contribution
  • Hybrid work schedule
  • Opportunity to work in a cutting-edge healthcare technology environment
  • Professional development opportunities and training
  • Collaborative and supportive work culture
  • Impactful role contributing to the enhancement of patient care and healthcare processes
    • If you need any accommodations for your interview please email HR@headlight.health prior to scheduling.

    Not meeting all the requirements? Research indicates that women, communities of color, and historically underrepresented individuals are often hesitant to apply for jobs unless they meet every qualification. We are committed to cultivating a diverse, inclusive, and genuine workplace. If you're enthusiastic about this position but your previous experience doesn't precisely match every qualification listed, we enthusiastically encourage you to submit your application. You could be the ideal candidate for this role or others!

    Headlight is committed to the principles of diversity, equity, and inclusiveness and seeks to create a working environment reflective of this commitment. We seek to provide a diverse clinician base to support the diversity of our clients. Headlight supports and respects diversity of people, culture, and ideas throughout our organization. Headlight thrives to be a welcoming, diverse and discrimination- and harassment-free workplace.

title: Transformational Platform Consultant
description:
As a Transformational Platform Consultant, you will be the technical strategist and storyteller who co-designs holistic, multi-year transformation visions for ServiceNow's most valuable customers—pulling them beyond point-product thinking into enterprise-scale operational transformation.


You will serve as the trusted technical advisor to 2–3 Elevate Pursuit Leads driving transformational deal development. You will design the customer's "North Star" operating model by architecting ServiceNow's platform strategy across workflow, intelligence, and governance layers. Unlike traditional solution consultants who validate product fit, you own the transformation narrative: you uncover what's possible, co-create the future state with customer executives, and position ServiceNow as the essential platform enabling that vision.
Your expertise will span ServiceNow's application portfolio, platform architecture, and enterprise transformation methodology. You'll lead discovery workshops, design and own the end-to-end technical value narrative, and maintain executive momentum across a 9–18 month transformation journey. You'll work hand-in-hand with Elevate Pursuit Leads, specialized product solution consultants, engineering, cross-functional product specialists, and account teams to translate customer pain into architectural possibility.


Core Responsibilities
Strategic Platform Architecture & Transformation Narrative

  • Co-design the customer's "North Star" operating model with Pursuit Leads and customer executives
  • Own the technical transformation narrative: articulate the "why" and "what" of the platform architecture, not just the "how"
  • Lead discovery workshops and ideation sessions that unlock what the customer hasn't yet imagined is possible
  • Translate customer business imperatives (cost, speed, experience, control, risk) into a coherent ServiceNow platform hypothesis that creates genuine competitive advantage
  • Uncover what's possible; position ServiceNow as the essential platform enabling that vision

Executive Engagement & Conviction-Building

  • Build and deliver the technical point of view for compelling C-level and board-level presentations that position the transformation as a business imperative, not an IT project
  • Drive C-suite conversations on business outcomes (revenue, efficiency, innovation, control, risk) and how ServiceNow platform architecture enables them
  • Move customers out of single-product or siloed-BU thinking into integrated, platform-centric operational models
  • Co-create transformation stories with Pursuit Leads and customer executives—building conviction through authentic partnership, not presentation
  • Maintain executive momentum across the 9–18 month journey, working through customer uncertainty and competing priorities

Technical Credibility & Methodology

  • Demonstrate authoritative knowledge of ServiceNow's platform architecture, workflow orchestration, AI governance, and integration patterns
  • Map customer use cases to appropriate ServiceNow products (ITSM, ITOM, CSM, FSM, GRC, CMDB, Intelligence) within a coherent platform strategy
  • Identify and articulate technical risks, integration dependencies, and architectural tradeoffs early
  • Partner with specialist solution consultants and product teams to validate platform feasibility and scope transformational architecture

Pursuit Deal Development & Strategy Partnership

  • Partner with Elevate Pursuit Leads on deal development strategy, technical approach, and customer engagement planning
  • Coordinate pre-sales discovery, architecture validation, and technical deliverables to maximize deal velocity and strategic value capture
  • Develop proposal architecture, transformation roadmaps, and go-live readiness assessments that reflect the 9–18 month journey
  • Ensure clean handoff to delivery teams with clear technical specifications, architecture documentation, and value-realization milestones
  • Own technical risk identification and mitigation across the deal cycle

Domain & Industry Leadership

  • Maintain deep understanding of industry-specific challenges, trends, and ServiceNow success patterns (e.g., Financial Services digital transformation, Healthcare interoperability, Manufacturing resilience)
  • Serve as a voice of the field: bringing customer feedback to Product and driving innovation in service of transformation outcomes
  • Contribute to Elevate enablement, battle cards, and industry-specific sales plays

Experience

  • 10+ years in enterprise pre-sales consulting, customer success, or solution architecture roles (ServiceNow experience preferred but not required)
  • Demonstrated success in account-based, long-cycle (12+ month) deal environments with C-level stakeholder engagement
  • Proven experience designing and owning end-to-end transformation strategies or operating model redesigns
  • Track record of building and delivering executive-level presentations and strategic recommendations

Technical Knowledge

  • Authoritative understanding of enterprise workflow platforms, business process automation, and IT service management principles
  • Working knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) best practices: incident, change, problem, and request management
  • Demonstrated technical knowledge of at least two major ServiceNow application modules (ITOM, CSM, FSM, GRC, CMDB, or Intelligence)
  • Comfort with enterprise architecture concepts: integration patterns, data governance, platform consolidation, and API-driven orchestration
  • Understanding of business process discovery, workflow design, and process optimization methodology

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Strong executive presence: ability to build credibility with C-suite, drive conversations, and influence strategic direction
  • Excellent storytelling and presentation skills: ability to craft compelling narratives, pivot messaging for different audiences, and drive conviction
  • Collaborative mindset: proven ability to work across sales, delivery, product, and customer teams toward shared outcomes
  • Problem-solving orientation: strong critical thinking, intellectual curiosity, and comfort with ambiguity in complex customer environments

Personal Attributes

  • Self-directed and proactive: ability to take ownership, manage competing priorities, and maintain momentum across long deal cycles
  • Customer-centric: genuine empathy for customer challenges, commitment to building transformation that sticks
  • Adaptable: ability to operate effectively across different customer cultures, industries, and stakeholder dynamics
  • Growth mindset: enthusiasm for learning new technologies, methodologies, and business domains

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow product expertise (platform, workflow, AI, or industry cloud experience)
  • Customer-side experience (having worked inside an enterprise on digital transformation or operational change initiatives)
  • Industry-specific domain expertise (Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Public Sector)
  • Sales process or GTM experience (understanding deal stages, buyer personas, and sales methodology)
  • Public speaking or conference presentation experience

title: Staff Power Engineer, Inverter
description:
Archer is an aerospace company based in San Jose, California building an all-electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft with a mission to advance the benefits of sustainable air mobility. We are designing, manufacturing, and operating an all-electric aircraft that can carry four passengers while producing minimal noise.

Our sights are set high and our problems are hard, and we believe that diversity in the workplace is what makes us smarter, drives better insights, and will ultimately lift us all to success. We are dedicated to cultivating an equitable and inclusive environment that embraces our differences, and supports and celebrates all of our team members.

What you’ll do:

  • Design and develop high voltage, high power density motor controller for eVTOL applications
  • Responsible for all aspects of power electronics designs required in an all-electric aircraft, from components to circuits, modules and system integration
  • Passive component design and optimization in power electronics systems
  • EMC testing and analysis for various power electronics systems
  • Leads new designs from conception into production while working with a multidisciplinary team
  • Start to finish ownership of hardware – from specification to design, prototype, reliability validation and manufacturing
    • Design MOSFET gate drive circuit, electronic power supply and sensing circuits
    • Schematic, layout and PCB assembly design and review
    • Design and carry out prototype verification tests for proof of concept
    • Analyze test data and reports to determine if the design meets functional and performance specifications.
    • Troubleshoot and help root cause any issues that occur in the prototype line.

What you need:

  • Electrical Engineering Degree or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant electrical system and circuit board design experience.
  • Sound knowledge and hands-on experience in traditional and modern power electronic technologies including (not limited to):
    • Inverter technology for variable speed motor drive (MOSFET, rectifiers and gate driver PWM technologies).
    • Passive power devices, e.g. inductors, capacitors, resistors and transformers.
    • Power electronics system architecture design and hardware integration.
    • Motor drive and power converters (AC-DC, DC-DC, DC-AC) control technologies.
    • Motor control and commutation methods for various types of three phase motors.
    • Microcontrollers
    • Sensor technology and implementation
    • Gate drive design for wide bandgap devices (SiC and GaN)
  • Experience with 50kW-200kW inverters at 400V-1000V
  • Experience in using schematic capture and circuit simulation software (e.g. Altium Designer or Xpedition).
  • PCB layout experience is strongly preferred
  • Experience performing circuit design analyses such as worst-case circuit analysis, fault analysis, and lifetime estimation
  • Master of all types of lab instruments: oscilloscope, EMC analyzers etc.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Hands on experience with DO-160G testing and DO-254 development
  • Ph. D. in power electronics
  • Embedded firmware development experience
  • Passion for aviation and eVTOL

Are you passionate about giving back to your community and serving youth? Join us!

Who We Are:
In 1922, Woodcraft Rangers opened its doors in Los Angeles and began its mission of guiding young people as they explore pathways to purposeful lives. As a progressive organization, Woodcraft has always been responsive to the evolving needs of the communities served, and is notably inclusive, youth-led, and rooted in the Woodcraft Way, a holistic framework that develops body, mind, spirit, and service. Continuously at the forefront of expanded learning opportunities, Woodcraft Rangers has a rich history of making a significant impact in the greater Los Angeles area, believing that all youth is innately good, deserves the opportunity to realize their full potential, and should be an active participant in defining their own path.

What We Do:
Woodcraft Rangers provides TK-12 expanded learning programs, including before and after school, specialty enrichment and summer learning. In the past few years, Woodcraft has expanded its menu of services beyond traditional afterschool programs and summer camps to include early learning, environmental and social justice, college access, and inclusion services for youth with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Additionally, we offer Lifecraft, a college and career advancement program to support the development of approximately 1,000 staff. Today, Woodcraft Rangers serves more than 20,000 youth ages 4-18 annually in and from 110+ Title I schools across LA County!

Club Leaders – Specialized program are responsible for ensuring a fun and positive learning environment for campers and will support clubs of up to 20 participants. title: Senior/Staff Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About Tahoe Therapeutics

Tahoe Therapeutics is a biotechnology company pioneering a fundamentally new approach to drug discovery, one that begins with the biology of real patients. Our Mosaic platform is the first to make in vivo data generation scalable, with single-cell resolution, allowing us to map how drugs affect patient-derived cells in the body across a wide range of biological contexts. We are building the world’s largest in vivo single-cell perturbation atlas and using it to train multimodal foundation models that learn the context-dependent nature of gene function, disease progression, and drug response.

By combining cutting-edge Machine Learning with the most biologically relevant datasets ever assembled in drug discovery, our mission is to find better drugs, faster and bring them to more patients who need them.

Your role

Tahoe is building AI-native tools that change how drug discovery gets done. Our flagship agentic product, Tara, is becoming the connective tissue across our platform: the way scientists, engineers, and models interact with our data, our models, and each other. Tara has to feel effortless while doing hard things underneath, including real-time reasoning, secure integrations, streaming interfaces, and multi-agent orchestration.

As a Senior/Staff Full-Stack Engineer, you will own product surface end-to-end and partner with our engineers, computational scientists, and ML team to make Tara robust, delightful, and secure. This role is well-suited for someone who has shipped real products at small teams, cares about the last mile (reliability, security, taste), and gets energy from working on AI-native problems where the right pattern is still being invented. We are looking for non-incremental thinkers who bring strong judgment on when to move fast, when to slow down, and when to reach for the right tool rather than build from scratch.

Qualifications - Required

  • Deep experience as a full-stack or product engineer at a startup or fast-moving team.

  • Track record of owning ambitious products end-to-end (frontend, backend, database, deployment) from concept to production.

  • Comfortable across a modern web stack and thoughtful about when to reach for which tool.

  • Proven track record of building reliable and secure applications at scale.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a small team where boundaries between roles are fluid.

Qualifications - Desirable

  • Experience integrating LLMs or agents into production systems: streaming responses, tool orchestration, multi-agent coordination, or long-running autonomous workflows.

  • Experience with observability and tracing for LLM or agentic systems (structured traces, cost attribution, replay, debugging when something goes wrong three tool calls deep).

  • The mindset of an early engineer at an AI-native or fast-moving startup: high ownership, comfort with ambiguity, and bias toward action balanced with judgment.

  • Interest in drug discovery, biology, or scientific tools. No formal background required, passion and curiosity are enough.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build Tara's end-to-end product surface: frontend, backend, real-time infrastructure, secure integrations.

  • Partner with engineers and scientists to translate research capabilities into product experiences our users love.

  • Tara is just the start. Build the next wave of AI-native tools and integrations that accelerate drug discovery at Tahoe.

  • Set the bar for full-stack craft on the team: how we approach reliability, real-time UX, product velocity, and debugging.

Benefits

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO).

  • Monthly Lunch budget

  • One-time Office set up budget

  • US Employees: HMO Kaiser Platinum and PPO Anthem Gold medical as well as vision and dental plans for both the employee and dependents.

The expected base salary range for this position is $150,000–$250,000. Actual compensation will depend on experience, skills, and location.

This position requires on-site presence at our South San Francisco office a minimum of three days per week.

We welcome applications from candidates in both Toronto, ON or San Francisco, CA, regions or those willing to relocate to the Bay Area or the Greater Toronto Area. Please note, we have one role open to two geographical locations.

title: Visual Inspector I
description:
ReviveRX is the premier licensed pharmacy specializing in health, wellness, and restorative medicine. We focus on treating the source, not just the symptoms, utilizing industry-leading technology. Collaborating with innovative pharmacists, healthcare providers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers, we provide personalized care. Our mission is to optimize treatment, revolutionize healthcare, and empower individuals to live vibrant lives. We welcome you to join us in our commitment to holistic wellness and personalized medicine.

Position Summary

The Visual Inspector I plays a critical role in safeguarding product quality and patient safety within a compounding pharmacy environment. This position is responsible for conducting thorough, hands-on visual inspections of pharmacy and wellness products using sensory evaluation techniques, sight, smell, and touch, along with non-specialized inspection tools, to identify defects, inconsistencies, or deviations from established quality standards before products reach the customer. Working closely with pharmacists and production teams, the Visual Inspector I helps ensure that every product meets rigorous compounding quality protocols, regulatory requirements, and company specifications. This role combines careful attention to detail with strong documentation practices, accurately recording inspection findings, identifying trends, and contributing to continuous improvement efforts that reduce quality issues over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct visual inspections of pharmacy and wellness products using human senses and non-specialized equipment
  • Utilize sensory evaluation (sight, smell, touch) to identify defects or inconsistencies
  • Perform regular quality assessments on all outgoing products to ensure they meet established specifications
  • Reject products that do not meet quality expectations and accurately document findings
  • Collaborate with the pharmacy team to ensure adherence to compounding quality protocols and regulatory requirements
  • Collaborate with production teams to ensure best practices in product handling and preparation
  • Maintain accurate records of inspection results, including any discrepancies or defects found
  • Prepare and submit detailed reports on quality assessments, trends, and recommendations for improvement
  • Ensure that products comply with design and safety specifications
  • Work closely with pharmacists and production staff to address quality concerns and enhance product quality
  • Provide training to team members on quality control standards and procedures, emphasizing attention to detail
  • Identify and resolve quality-related issues promptly, implementing corrective actions as necessary
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives to prevent future quality issues
  • Perform other related duties as required and assigned

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Registered Pharmacy Technician with the Texas State Board of Pharmacy (Pharmacy Technician Trainees are welcome to apply)
  • 1+ years of experience as a certified pharmacy technician or as a trainee
  • Some experience in using inspection tools and equipment, such as magnifying glasses and measuring devices
  • Strong observational skills with a focus on precision
  • Ability to analyze data and make informed decisions based on inspection findings
  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive approach to quality issues
  • Ability to work with pharmacy software, cloud-based communication tools, and mobile platforms
  • Strong attention to detail, reliable time management, and a team-oriented attitude
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and prioritize tasks

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1+ years of experience in quality control or visual inspection within a compounding pharmacy or pharmaceutical environment

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Fast-paced pharmacy setting requiring multitasking and attention to detail
  • Collaborative team environment with cross-functional exposure to compounding, fulfillment, and clinical coordination
  • May require occasional remote or telephonic patient interactions
  • Ability to stand for extended periods during shifts
  • Frequent use of hands for typing, data entry, and medication preparation

title: Global Delivery (Manila), Officer
description:
We are seeking a Global Delivery Operations Officer to support the delivery of high-quality operational services across a global financial services environment. This role is suited to an experienced operations professional who can manage day-to-day deliverables, support service quality, monitor controls, resolve issues, coordinate with stakeholders, and contribute to continuous improvement across multiple operational teams.
The successful candidate will bring strong attention to detail, sound judgment, a client-focused mindset, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global, and deadline-driven environment. This is a hands-on Officer-level role requiring ownership, accountability, operational discipline, and the ability to guide others while supporting consistent, controlled, and timely service delivery.

Why This Role Is Important

Global Delivery Operations plays a key role in ensuring that clients, business partners, and internal stakeholders receive accurate, timely, and well-controlled operational services. The Officer will help maintain strong execution standards, support operational controls, manage exceptions, contribute to risk reduction, and improve the overall quality and efficiency of delivery.
This role is important because it helps connect daily operations with broader business outcomes: client service, operational resilience, process consistency, quality management, control effectiveness, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

As a Global Delivery Operations Officer, you will:
  • Support daily operational delivery across assigned processes, ensuring work is completed accurately, on time, and in line with established procedures and service expectations.
  • Monitor production workflows, calendars, queues, deliverables, and exceptions to ensure operational activities remain on track.
  • Perform review, validation, and quality checks on operational outputs, reports, data, transactions, documentation, or other deliverables as required.
  • Investigate and resolve operational issues, discrepancies, queries, and exceptions, escalating risks or delays appropriately.
  • Act as a point of contact for internal teams, business partners, client-facing groups, and other stakeholders on operational matters.
  • Support adherence to policies, procedures, controls, service standards, and regulatory or compliance requirements applicable to the function.
  • Maintain and update process documentation, standard operating procedures, checklists, trackers, and control evidence.
  • Track, review, and report operational metrics, including volumes, timeliness, quality, aging items, service levels, issue trends, and key risk indicators.
  • Identify process gaps, control weaknesses, recurring issues, or inefficiencies, and recommend practical improvements.
  • Participate in operational change initiatives, process migrations, system enhancements, automation opportunities, and continuous improvement projects.
  • Support internal and external audits, risk reviews, control testing, client due diligence, business continuity activities, and remediation actions as required.
  • Collaborate with teams across locations and functions to ensure consistent execution, effective handoffs, and timely issue resolution.
  • Provide guidance, training, and knowledge-sharing to junior team members, helping build team capability and operational resiliency.
