title: Learning Scientist
description:
About ALX Africa

ALX Africa, a non-profit organisation under the ALX Foundation, is dedicated to unlocking the potential of Africa's digital future. Formerly part of Sand Tech Holdings, we've embarked on an independent journey to provide world-class tech skills training and career acceleration programmes. Our mission is to bridge the digital divide, upskill and re-skill talent, and create a generation of innovative leaders. By 2030, we aim to empower 2 million Africans to secure sustainable tech careers.

With hubs in 8 cities across Africa and counting, we provide safe access to quality learning and a dedicated network of expert instructors. Our innovative programmes equip learners with the practical skills and knowledge needed to succeed in today's rapidly evolving tech industry. Through a combination of rigorous coursework, industry partnerships, and hands-on projects, we prepare our students for in-demand roles in software engineering, data science, and cybersecurity.

We achieve this by:

  • Providing young professionals with access to the most in-demand tech skills that will power the future.
  • Empowering the next generation of technology innovators, entrepreneurs, and business leaders through challenging, real-world coursework.
  • Building a lifelong, impactful community of tech professionals that support them at all stages of their career journey.

Our impact thus far:

  • 347k+ graduates since 2020
  • 257k youth in work
  • 31k youth starting own ventures
  • 60k youth in jobs created by entrepreneurs

Visit our website to learn more about our digital revolution.

Role Summary

ALX teaches at scale across Africa, and Project A is the AI layer of that: AI profiles and onboards learners, guides them through projects, and a competency engine decides what they should learn next. Every one of those products embeds pedagogical assumptions — about scaffolding, feedback, productive struggle, and what an AI guide should and shouldn’t do for a learner. The Learning Scientist makes those assumptions explicit, grounds them in modern learning science, and tests them. There is a proper handover: the role is currently held by a team member who transitions out in about six months, so you overlap with her rather than start cold.

You will work in collaboration with Anthropic Engineers, a team of AI engineers, product managers and data scientists to design world class learning experiences.

Specific Responsibilities

Pedagogical Direction

  • Guide the pedagogical decisions across the platform — input at design time, learning-efficacy judgment at eval time.
  • Adapt and interpret the ALX learning framework so the platform is informed by real pedagogy rather than decorated with it.

Experimentation & Product Collaboration

  • Design experiments against the platform’s core pedagogical assumptions, run with our experimentation function — for example, is the tutor guidance helping learners or crutching them?
  • Assist in designing and evaluating the AI products alongside engineers, translating learning science into concrete product decisions.

Skill Requirements - Essential

  • Learning science: solid grounding — you can cite and apply modern frameworks, not just intuitions from teaching.
  • AI literacy: you understand what LLM-based tools can and can’t do, well enough to co-design them with engineers.
  • Experiment design: hypotheses, measures, and enough methodological rigour to test learning claims honestly.
  • Desirable (not required): prior EdTech product work; familiarity with competency frameworks or knowledge tracing; experience with African education contexts.

Essential Traits for Success

  • Your instinct is to challenge the team’s assumptions, including the technical lead’s — that’s the job.
  • You translate across disciplines without friction and enjoy being embedded in an engineering team.
  • You can describe a pedagogical belief you changed your mind about, and the evidence that did it.

Person Specification/Attributes

  • Courage: Willingness to speak up, challenge the status quo, and embrace new challenges.
  • Humility: Openness to learning, seeking help when needed, and a focus on serving others.
  • Adventure: A passion for setting ambitious goals, tackling difficult tasks, and finding joy in the journey.
  • Initiative: Proactive problem-solving, a sense of ownership, and a willingness to go above and beyond.
  • Resilience: The ability to bounce back from setbacks, persevere through challenges, and emerge stronger.

Employment Type

This role is a full-time position.

Preferred Time Zones

The preferred time zones are GMT+2.

title: Security Associate - 1st Shift
description:

  • Full-Time hourly Position with a competitive wage.
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

  • Ability to organize, plan, and execute multiple tasks in a fast-paced work environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of CCTV, RFID, Card Access, and other Safe and Secure Technology
  • Previous experience supporting an OSHA program – Safety Team
  • Experience supporting crisis prevention and/or response plans

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you:

  • Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English
  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • This job position is designated as a safety-sensitive position

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

If you like disrupting the norm and are looking to join a company revolutionizing an industry then you will LOVE what Carvana has done for the car buying experience. Buying a car the old fashioned way sucks and we are working hard to make it NOT suck. I mean, have you seen our vending machine?!

title: Product Engineer, New Products
description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role

As a Product Engineer, you’ll take emerging ideas from concept to polished experiences. You’ll build sophisticated, intuitive user experiences while working across AI models, agentic workflows, and all parts of web infrastructure to ship complete products.


The Goal: Build products that can define major new categories for Replit. You will combine the flexibility of software with the accessibility of presentations, spreadsheets, dashboards, and visual editors, enabling anyone to create powerful, interactive artifacts through natural language.

The Audience: We build for the next generation of creators, knowledge workers, and high-leverage teams. Our users should be able to turn an idea, dataset, or business problem into a polished, editable, and shareable product just by themselves.

Candidates who thrive here often have the product judgment, technical range, and ownership mindset associated with founders. This is a high-visibility role working closely with product leadership.


How we work

Structure: We operate as a collective of in-house technical founders, not narrowly specialized engineers. Initiatives are run by lean, autonomous teams built for velocity and technical leverage. Engineers maintain meaningful ownership over technical direction, product quality, and launch success, supported by Product and Design partners.

Cadence: We work in focused three-week sprints, shipping quickly, observing real user behavior, and incorporating feedback into each iteration. We value decisive execution, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to make progress without perfectly defined requirements.


What you’ll do

  • Own major product experiences from initial concept through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and continued improvement

  • Invent and build intuitive interfaces for generating, editing, arranging, and collaborating on AI-created presentations, data applications, and visual artifacts

  • Deliver exceptional frontend experiences across interaction design, typography, layout, motion, accessibility, performance, and error recovery

  • Partner directly with users, Product, Design, and AI engineers to understand real workflows, test ideas, and turn feedback into better products

  • Create reusable editing, visualization, and collaboration primitives that accelerate future products across Replit


Required Skills and Experience

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of shipping high-quality, user-facing products

  • Understanding of the full agentic software development stack, helping coding agents build, test and review correct code

  • Deep experience with TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, along with strong knowledge of browser performance, application state, responsive design, and accessibility

  • Strong product judgment and visual taste, with the ability to balance usability, speed, correctness, polish, and long-term maintainability

  • Comfort working across the full stack, including Node.js, APIs, Postgres, data models, and production debugging

  • Familiarity with agentic software development and how coding agents build, test, review, and operate software


Bonus Points

  • Building visual editors, presentation software, creative tools, data applications, developer tools, or collaboration products

  • Working with canvas or graphics systems, rich text, direct manipulation, real-time collaboration, data visualization, or complex interactive interfaces

  • Designing user experiences around AI generation, streaming responses, tool calls, and long-running agent workflows

  • Founding a technical company, working as a founding engineer, or shipping a high-visibility independent project

These experiences are preferred, but not required. We care most about what you have built, the quality of your product thinking, and your ability to learn quickly.


Example Projects You’ll Work On

  • Building on top of our Replit Slides AI-native presentation product where users can generate beautiful decks, directly edit elements, collaborate with others, and reliably export their work

  • Enable Replit Agent to turn raw datasets and natural-language questions into interactive, trustworthy data applications

  • Design visual tools that make AI-generated work feel as precise, editable, and controllable as traditionally authored content

  • Build reusable editing, visualization, collaboration, and artifact-management systems that power multiple new Replit products

  • Develop feedback loops and evaluations that improve the visual quality of Agent-generated artifacts

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

title: Senior Creative Operations Lead, Brand
description:

You operate as a highly senior individual contributor and strategic operator, acting as a trusted partner to Creative Directors, Associate Creative Directors, and Marketing leadership. Your work brings calm to complexity, alignment across teams, and rigor to how creative work is planned, delivered, and sustained.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Planning, Capacity & Delivery Enablement

  • Set clear expectations around scope, timelines, and delivery—and hold teams accountable
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, guiding teams toward resolution
  • Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities with confidence, diplomacy, and decisiveness

Systems, Process & Tooling

Financial & Vendor Stewardship

WHO YOU ARE

  • Thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments

  • Thinks in systems, not tasks; designs processes that scale

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $116,000 and $183,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $136,000 and $218,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

#LI-Hybrid

WHAT WE OFFER

Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country here. More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment.

From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we’ve got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

ABOUT BRAZE

Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™. Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

We service all of California from multiple locations. At City Rise Traffic, we provide high-quality traffic control safety services to construction sites, such as flagging traffic through a work site, lane closures to divert traffic, or detouring traffic to reduce traffic congestion and prevent accidents. Our focus is safety, so our customers can focus on their jobs.


Position Summary:
The Traffic Control Lead possesses a general knowledge of principles and practices of supervision. The Lead is expected to safely execute all scopes of traffic control work, including but not limited to flagging setups, single to multi-lane closures, road closures, detours, freeway closures, specialty projects, and field supervision.
Outside of the standard Lead job site duties, the Lead will draw on their own knowledge and experience to assist in the onsite training and development of our traffic control employees. The Lead will collaborate with safety & training and field operations to maintain job-site compliance through employee evaluations, jobsite inspections, onsite training, and performance reviews.

• Supervise job site

• Implement Traffic Plans & Permits

• Onsite client contact
• Maintain a consistent and unrelenting focus on safety throughout all job functions.
• Manage day-to-day work zone set up, maintenance and tear down. Meeting or exceeding customer, state, federal and company expectations
• Ability to recognize dangers using hearing and vision

• Ability to understand traffic signals/signs, traffic plans and customer requests

title: Process Improvement Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven Process Improvement Manager to lead operational excellence initiatives across our organization. In this role, you will identify inefficiencies, analyze business processes, implement scalable solutions, and use data to drive continuous improvement.


This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex operational challenges, optimizing workflows, and building systems that improve productivity, quality, and performance. You will partner with leadership and cross-functional teams to standardize processes, develop performance metrics, and create a culture of continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities


Process Optimization

  • Evaluate existing business processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Design, implement, and continuously refine scalable workflows that improve operational efficiency.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process maps, and documentation.
  • Lead cross-functional process improvement initiatives from planning through implementation.

Data Analysis & Performance Management

  • Analyze operational data to identify trends, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop dashboards and reports that provide leadership with actionable business insights.
  • Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational effectiveness.
  • Present data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies.
  • Establish best practices and standardized processes across departments.
  • Measure the effectiveness of process improvements and recommend ongoing enhancements.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Systems & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes using workflow automation tools.
  • Collaborate with technology teams to implement system enhancements and improve operational workflows.
  • Ensure data accuracy, system integrity, and effective utilization of business applications.
  • Support implementation of new technologies that improve operational performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with department leaders to understand operational challenges and develop practical solutions.
  • Facilitate workshops and meetings to gather process requirements and drive alignment.
  • Train employees on new processes, procedures, and operational best practices.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on process improvement and operational strategy.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in Process Improvement, Business Operations, Continuous Improvement, Project Management, Operations Management, or Business Analysis.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional process improvement initiatives.
  • Experience developing operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, and advanced formulas.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
  • Familiarity with workflow automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, Microsoft Power Automate, or similar tools.
  • Experience with process mapping tools such as Visio, Lucidchart, or Miro is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Project management experience (PMP or similar certification is a plus).
  • Experience working in professional services, healthcare, legal, financial services, or other process-driven industries.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive organizational change.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and highly detail-oriented.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
About Us

Farsight is the agentic AI platform for financial services, currently helping investment banks and private equity firms fully automate entire, highly nuanced workflows. Today, institutions will spend 80% of their time gathering information for and creating first drafts of materials by hand before iterating on and refining their decks, models, and pitches.

Farsight is partnered with S&P Global and has the opportunity to shape the future of financial services!

Our team comes from Evercore, General Atlantic, Amazon, Hugging Face, founding engineers of other startups, and plenty more!

The Role

Farsight is moving fast, and as our product and enterprise customer base scale, the way we coordinate work across our technical teams has become one of our highest priorities. This role exists to make that happen.

As our Technical Project Manager, you will sit at the intersection of our Software Engineering, AI, and Infrastructure & Security teams. You will own our application lifecycle management process end to end: every project — from enterprise feature commitments to internal platform work — will run through the process you operate, with clear requirements, owners, sequencing, and timelines at every stage.

You will work as the direct counterpart to our Product Manager. The Product Manager brings priorities, requirements, and customer context in from our GTM org; you turn those into scoped, sequenced, and tracked projects across the technical teams, and deliver realistic timelines — built from estimates by the engineers doing the work — back up so GTM always knows where things stand. Together, you and the Product Manager will jointly prioritize the roadmap based on customer importance on one side and engineering cost, dependencies, and duration on the other.

Today, much of this coordination is done ad hoc by our engineers on top of their day jobs. Your success means they never have to do it again.

This is not a coordination role for someone who likes to run meetings. It is a high-ownership, high-impact position for someone who gets uncomfortable when things are unclear and fixes them. This is a role reporting to our COO!

What You'll Do

  • Own our application lifecycle management process end to end — every project moves through clearly defined stages with documented requirements, owners, and definitions of done, and you make sure nothing gets lost, stalled, or misunderstood along the way

  • Build project timelines from estimates provided by the engineers doing the work, track progress against them, and communicate status and changes to the Product Manager and GTM org so expectations always match reality

  • Partner with the Product Manager to jointly prioritize projects, weighing customer and GTM importance against engineering effort, dependencies, and tradeoffs

  • Coordinate requirements, sequencing, and dependencies across the Software Engineering, AI, and Infrastructure & Security teams — including the security and scalability work required to take features from working to enterprise-ready — so no team is blocking another

  • Manage projects with hard customer deadlines: identify risks early, and when things take longer than expected, drive the decision on what to cut, resequence, or renegotiate to get delivery back on track

  • Take coordination and process work off our engineers' plates so they can focus on building

  • Run sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives with a focus on velocity and clarity, not ceremony

  • Surface blockers early, escalate when needed, and drive resolution without creating overhead

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in technical project management, program management, or a closely related role, ideally at a startup or high-growth tech company

  • Strong technical fluency: you don't need to write code, but you need to understand how software gets built, what makes something technically complex, and why timelines slip

  • Proven ability to coordinate across multiple technical teams — software engineering, AI/ML, infrastructure, DevOps, security — and translate between them

  • Experience building realistic delivery timelines from engineering estimates and holding teams accountable to them without burning trust

  • Highly organized with a low tolerance for ambiguity: you create clarity where others leave things vague

Above and Beyond Qualifications

  • Experience at an AI-native startup where non-deterministic systems added coordination complexity

  • Experience delivering into enterprise environments with security, compliance, or infrastructure requirements

  • Experience introducing or operating a project lifecycle process at a company that didn't have one before

Compensation

  • Base salary range of $130,000–$180,000. Commensurate with experience

  • Equity: Meaningful early-stage package with standard vesting (4 year / 1-year cliff)

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance

  • Unlimited PTO

Farsight AI is an equal opportunity employer.

Farsight is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: Strategic Analytics - Associate
description:
We are seeking motivated individuals interested in analytics and problem solving to join the Digital Fraud Strategy team . The Digital Fraud Strategy team is responsible for leveraging advanced analytical tools to protect customers from fraud and scams in the digital payments space (Zelle, bill pay, wire transfers, ACH, funds transfers, and real time payments). We leverage machine learning fraud models, overlain with vendor and in-house data as well as an array of analytical techniques to develop risk rules and strategies.

The primary objective of the team is to act as the end to end owner of fraud loss management of digital activity. The team focuses on three main areas: i.) Reducing fraud losses through identification of trends and development of strategies/business rules, ii.) reducing the cost of fraud alerts, by improving the efficiency of the alerts and/or automating review processes, and iii.) reducing negative customer experience and complaints by understanding points of friction and brainstorming solutions to resolve common pain points.

We are seeking individuals with intellectual curiosity and strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills. The candidate should possess a natural curiosity to explore the unknown.

A successful candidate in this role will be strong analytically, while also able to convey trends, changes, and strategies to senior leadership both verbally and through text/PowerPoint. They should be an outside the box thinker with a desire/ability to work as a part of team towards a common goal.

The key skills for the job are:

  • Ability to develop new creative solutions to challenges presented by fraud activity leveraging outside the box thinking.
  • Manipulate and understand large amounts of complex data to monitor and uncover behaviors and trends in fraudulent activity.
  • Experience with SAS and SQL or other analytical programming
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate complex data into a clear story to team members as well as senior leaders.
  • A desire to work as part of a team, and ability to work with cross functional teams
  • The ability to develop new fraud fighting products by designing requirements and working with technical business partners to implement these products using agile design methodology
  • The ability to work on diverse tasks and respond to emerging issues
  • Candidate should have a passion for problem solving

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of professional experience, experience in risk management, strategic analytics, or data science preferred
  • Strong analytical, interpretive and problem solving skills with the ability to interpret large amounts of data and its impact in both operational and financial areas
  • Ability to compress large amounts of data into short and concise presentations with sound business conclusions
  • Ability to develop elegant and common-sense solutions to complex business challenges
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to comprehend and explain data / concepts in a clear and concise manner
  • Strong knowledge of programming language like: Python, SAS, R and SQL
  • Proficient in Excel & PowerPoint
  • Demonstrated experience with data analysis, designing & analyzing experiments, and simplifying/communicating complex topics
  • Strong P&L knowledge and understanding of drivers of profitability

title: Quant Trading Associate - 2027 Start
description:
Chicago Trading Company (CTC) is a premier proprietary trading firm specializing in options market making. Our collaborative culture fuels innovation in quantitative research, systematic trading strategies, and cutting-edge trading technology. For over three decades CTC has provided critical liquidity across derivatives exchanges worldwide - making them fairer, more transparent, and more efficient.

We strive to be the most innovative firm in the industry today, tomorrow, and long into the future while upholding ethical excellence. We believe that CTC makes a positive impact on the markets, the lives of our employees, and all the communities to which we belong. Started in 1995 by a team of forward-thinking Traders, we are proud to call ourselves an industry leader that keeps making markets and each other better.

Are you excited by the opportunity to be part of a dynamic trading environment that values teamwork and collaboration? Do you thrive in an innovative atmosphere? If so, we encourage you to consider Chicago Trading Company!

The Role

The Quant Trading Associate (QTA) role is our entry-level position within our Trading and Quant organization and gives you broad exposure to the whole business as you work towards graduating from the Associate Program and assuming a role as a Quant Trader or Quant Researcher.

As a QTA, you will work in a high-impact role as a member of a trading or quantitative team. You will play a vital part in identifying trading opportunities and impacting your team through dynamic problem solving — including trade execution, strategy formulation, back-testing, data analysis, and the modeling and pricing of traded financial derivatives — while communicating with traders, risk managers, software engineers, and quants throughout the trading day. You will learn all aspects of the trading and quant operation and work towards a role that generates trading revenue or drives strategy development for the team. In addition to the trading and quantitative side of the business, you will have exposure to technology through our combined trading and technology curriculum.

We encourage competitiveness and collaboration in equal measure and strive to better each other to win as one team.

What to Expect

Due to the dynamic nature of this business, we cultivate an environment of continuous learning and growth through an in-house education department. Through formal classroom work, mock trading, and real-time practical exposure, you will gain a holistic introduction to the derivatives market while sharpening your quantitative skillset. You can expect:

  • An introduction to options pricing, theory, trading philosophies, and programming courses
  • Exposure to different product areas and responsibilities
  • One-on-one mentorship from senior members in the firm
  • Opportunities to grow quickly and start making autonomous trading decisions
  • Participation in data-driven research for the purpose of alpha generation

What it takes for you to be successful:

  • You have a competitive drive and are a highly motivated individual that only gets stronger as part of a collaborative team
  • An aspiration to collaborate with traders, quants, developers, and other experts to further CTC's goal of providing world class liquidity to financial markets
  • You love solving complex problems
  • You're intellectually curious and like to challenge the status quo
  • You can effectively communicate sophisticated ideas both written and verbally
  • Strong quantitative and analytical abilities
  • Basic programming skills or a willingness to learn Python
  • No prior experience in finance is necessary, but a deep curiosity and a hunger to learn is essential

Key requirements:

  • Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree. All majors and concentrations welcome.
  • You will graduate between December 2026-June 2027
  • You have a demonstrated record of success (academics, awards, etc.)
  • You are willing to relocate to Chicago, IL

Why should you consider a career at CTC?

  • Be part of a fast-growing, industry-leading global trading company
  • Work in an environment that actively explores and applies emerging technologies — including AI — to enhance trading, engineering, and research workflows
  • Opportunity to work with and learn from forward-thinking leaders in our industry
  • Experience innovation, teamwork, and fun while working in an intellectually stimulating environment
  • Join an ambitious, collaborative workplace where there is no limit to what you can learn and what you will be able to contribute
  • Excellent growth potential
  • Competitive pay and comprehensive benefits package including free breakfast and lunch (and healthy snacks of course!) as well as a fitness center membership

Compensation

The salary range for this role is listed below. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. The discretionary bonus will be dependent upon the individual’s skills, experience, qualifications, and firm performance.

Salary Range
$175,000—$175,000 USD

title: Sheriff’s Sergeant - San Francisco Sheriff's Office (8308/8508) - Promotional Only
description:
Under direction, the Sheriff’s Sergeant functions as a line-level supervisor in the Custody, Field Operations, Administration and Programs, and Planning and Projects divisions: performs a variety of duties relating to the supervision of inmates in custody; serves as a supervisor of bailiffs in civil, criminal, and juvenile courts; serves as a field or support services supervisor in the enforcement of civil processes; supervises other sworn or civilian staff in the performance of law enforcement and administrative duties related to investigations, training, technical services, warrants service, inmate transportation, personnel management, fiscal administration, and public building and grounds security; performs and supervises performance of related law enforcement duties as assigned.

According to Civil Service Commission Rule 109, the duties specified below are representative of the range of duties as assigned to this class(es) and are not intended to be an inclusive list.

  1. Supervises sworn staff in the care and control of inmates in the county jail or jail alternative programs; supervises maintaining of order and security in and around jail facilities; supervises line staff in the performance of routine jail duties such as cell inspections and searches, contraband searches and seizures, movement, recreation, counts, meals, visits, mail, commissary, medical calls, and other day-to-day jail operations; performs related facility area administrative duties involving operating a computer terminal, making arithmetical calculations, posting and explaining policies and procedures, investigating inmate grievances or disciplinary actions, and preparing detailed narrative reports; serves as Assistant Watch Commander; serves as acting Watch Commander in the absence of a regularly assigned commander or higher rank.
  2. Assumes facility area command in the event of jail emergencies or extraordinary events such as fights, riots, fires, criminal acts, or other situations; intervenes to diffuse potential problem situations, by identifying inmate emotional and physical conditions; supervises movement of inmates under exceptional circumstances; assures proper documentation of jail emergencies.
  3. Supervises bailiffs in civil, criminal, and juvenile courts.
  4. Serves as field operations or support services supervisor in receiving and enforcement of civil processes.
  5. Supervises and performs law enforcement and administrative duties related to criminal, internal affairs, or background investigations; supervises performance of duties of law enforcement and jail operations training officers assigned to the Training Unit; supervises warrants service for the Central Records and Warrants Unit and Community Programs, including general administrative oversight and field operations; supervises inmate transportation, including inter-facility transportation, out-of-country transportation, and transfers of arrestees from Police Department district stations to the county jail; supervises personnel functions, hiring, performance evaluations, disability accounting, and related operations; performs and supervises sworn and civilian staff in public building and grounds security operations, including monitoring of visitor ingress through metal detectors, maintaining order in public buildings and grounds, and roving patrol of access points; serves as commander of established Sections, Units, and other subdivisions of the San Francisco Sheriff's Office.

  1. Experience: A total of four (4) years of experience in the San Francisco Sheriff’s Office in classes 8302 Deputy Sheriff I/8304/8504 Deputy Sheriff/8306/8506 Senior Deputy Sheriff; or any combination of the above-mentioned classes; AND

Role Description

As a Staff Product Designer on Bridge, you will lead multiple highly-visible design initiatives that deliver against Dropbox’s strategic bets around AI. This role will require you to lead with vision, driving strategic initiatives that blend design excellence with customer empathy and innovation. You will also help shape our team’s culture, personally role modeling excellence across strategy, interaction and visual design, prototyping, and storytelling.

Responsibilities

  • Problem definition: Define high-level opportunities that have the potential to transform the user experience and business outcomes. Bring clarity, insight, and strategic focus to these challenges.

Requirements

  • 10-15+ years in a senior Individual Contributor role, with a proven track record of leading complex design initiatives with simple and elegant solutions.
  • A portfolio showcasing significant contributions to shipping customer experiences that have made a measurable impact on business and customer metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with various stakeholder groups, including engineering, product management, and leadership, influencing design strategy and ensuring successful execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence key stakeholders. Strong storytelling skills to present and advocate for design decisions.
  • Familiarity leveraging generative AI for exploration and prototyping.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven ability to lead design efforts in remote or distributed team environments, driving collaboration across time zones and organizational silos.
  • Leadership driving company-wide initiatives to up-level design quality (ex: teaching prototyping classes or mentoring other designers).

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: Specialized Behavior Assistant

The Lansing School District serves over 10,000 PreK-12 students across 25 school buildings in the increasingly diverse urban community of Lansing, MI. We are unique compared to other districts because of the wide variety of exciting and innovative educational options from which families and staff members can choose. All of Lansing School District’s team members are dedicated to our mission to provide an excellent education to all students in a safe and nurturing environment.

In pursuit of this mission, we are looking to hire for a Specialized Assistant role. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, supportive learning environment where every student thrives. As a Specialized Behavior Assistant, you will work closely with students who require behavioral supports, collaborating with teachers, behavior specialists, and families to help each child reach their educational and social goals.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 60 completed college credits
  • Proof of passing the ETS Paraprofessional Exam

  • Communicate regularly with teachers, specialists, and families regarding student progress and challenges

  • Must be able to lift, push, or carry up to 50 pounds as needed.

title: Operational Initiatives Administrator
description:
Job Summary:

Some roles are defined by a title. This one is defined by the person in it.

As our Operational Initiatives Administrator, you are the connective tissue between our team, our office environment, and our company culture. You keep the rhythm of the business on track — not by being told what to do, but by reading what's needed before anyone has to ask. You take pride in an environment that's polished, a team that's informed, and a team that's supported.


This is a high-visibility, high-trust role. This is an experienced operational role for someone who has already proven they can run a complex environment independently and is looking for a place where that expertise is recognized and rewarded. You'll report to the HR Director and, over time, provide scheduling and calendar support as directed. You may come from an operations background, an office management background, and/or early-stage HR — what matters more than your path is your judgment, your discretion, and your ability to operate with professionalism in every interaction.


Location: This role is based out of our Grandville, MI office and requires consistent onsite presence five (5) days per week based on business needs. Standard business hours are 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; while we understand hours may flex with business needs, occasional remote flexibility may be available post-probationary period as previously noted. Reliable commutability to our Grandville office is a non-negotiable requirement for consideration.


Key Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and execute complex scheduling with external parties or for operational initiatives.
  • Support the development and distribution of internal communications content that keeps the team informed, connected, and culturally aligned.
  • Maintain the office environment in a constant state of readiness, ensuring all physical spaces are polished and professional, and serving as the primary point of contact for facility inquiries and immediate office needs.
  • Support company-wide meetings, overseeing video systems, live chat engagement, and presentation flow.
  • Conduct daily walkthroughs of the office to identify and resolve any facility or aesthetic issues before they impact the team.
  • Manage vendor relationships and support office inventory needs to ensure the facility is fully stocked and operational at all times.
  • Coordinate and execute internal culture projects, employee recognition initiatives, and onsite events in support of leadership-driven priorities, ensuring all logistics, catering, tech, and materials are confirmed well in advance.
  • Provide flexible HR administrative support including maintenance and filing of employee records, talent acquisition coordination, and onboarding logistics.
  • Support talent acquisition logistics including interview scheduling, candidate communications, and coordination as directed by the HR Director.
  • Provide administrative support to the Compliance division which can include, but is not limited to, special projects, documentation, and operational initiatives.
  • Other job duties, as assigned.



Required Skills & Abilities:

  • A Professional Mindset
    • A proactive attitude with a passion for creating a welcoming and high-functioning office environment.
    • A hospitality-first approach to office management, ensuring common areas, meeting rooms, and shared spaces are consistently functional, polished, and inviting.
    • Exceptional situational awareness and the ability to solve problems or anticipate needs before they escalate.
    • Proven ability to handle confidential information with the utmost discretion and sound judgment.
    • Ability to remain flexible and calm under pressure while managing shifting priorities and competing demands.
    • A visible, high-energy presence who actively engages with the office environment and the people in it.
  • Communication & Professional Judgment
    • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to draft professional messages that match the company tone and audience.
    • Ability to evaluate how operational and administrative decisions impact team morale, culture, and leadership alignment.
    • Demonstrated ability to assess when to move independently versus when a decision requires leadership visibility or input.
    • Exceptional verbal skills for professional interaction with colleagues, executives, and external partners.
  • Technical Execution
    • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Slack, and video conferencing platforms, with the ability to troubleshoot basic AV and hardware issues independently.
    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities with meticulous attention to detail, working independently in a fast-paced, complex environment.
    • Experience in vendor relations and coordination, ensuring high standards of service delivery and cost-effectiveness.



Preferred Skills & Abilities:

  • Working knowledge of AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini).
  • A basic eye for layout and design (e.g., Canva or PowerPoint) to support internal documentation, office signage, and culture and recognition materials.



Education & Experience:

While a Bachelor's degree is preferred, we are more interested in what you've done than where you studied. Candidates with a Bachelor's degree and a minimum of three (3) years of relevant experience, or a minimum of five (5) years of experience without a degree, across operations or office administration are encouraged to apply. We value your judgment, your discretion, and your track record of making complex environments look effortless.



Preferred Experience can include, but may not be limited to:

  • Chamber, association, nonprofit, or startup/SMB (small-to-mid-size business) background
  • Event logistics and coordination
  • Non-profit experience
  • Internal branding and culture material execution
  • Working knowledge of HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) or ATS (Applicant Tracking System)
  • Cross-functional or executive-facing coordination



Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs as needed for office logistics and event setup.
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods throughout the workday.
  • Ability to move throughout the office regularly, including walking between spaces and performing daily walkthroughs.
  • Ability to perform light physical tasks related to office setup, breakdown, and maintenance as needed.
  • Ability to access and navigate confined or limited-access spaces as needed for facility maintenance or equipment troubleshooting.
  • Ability to operate standard office equipment including computers, printers, and AV hardware.
  • Ability to use hands and fingers for keyboard operation, equipment handling, and physical setup tasks.



Total Rewards & Culture

  • Financial & Future Security
    • Salary commensurate with experience and regular performance reviews.
    • 401(k) retirement plan to help you reach your long-term financial goals.
    • Company-paid Short-Term and Long-Term Disability, plus additional optional and voluntary life insurance plans.
  • Health & Wellness
    • Premium insurance package (e.g. medical, dental, vision, pet insurance, etc).
    • Priority access to our diagnostic evaluation(s).
    • Paid Time Off (PTO)
    • Ten (10) observed Paid Holidays (including your birthday!)
  • The Hybrid Work Experience
    • A flexible hybrid model, designed to balance deep work with team synergy.
    • Our office features a regularly stocked pantry and pop machine with four (4) flavors to keep you fueled.
    • Regular company meetings provided lunches.
    • We welcome your well-behaved companions through our canine pet policy.
  • Growth & Connection
    • Professional development opportunities
    • A dedicated Professional Development Reimbursement Program to support your growth.
    • Team-building events to foster a strong organizational culture.



Equal Opportunity

Mentavi Health is an equal-opportunity employer. We embrace and encourage differences in age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, national origin, physical and mental ability, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, and other characteristics that make our employees unique. We encourage and welcome diverse candidates to apply for any position you are qualified to bring your unique perspective to our team. To be considered for this position, candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, TN, etc.) for this role now or in the future. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

title: Senior Editor, CNBC Make It
description:
CNBC is the recognized world leader in business news and provides real-time financial market coverage and business information to over 400 million homes worldwide. CNBC also delivers content across a variety of digital platforms such as: CNBC.com; CNBC+, CNBC PRO, The CNBC Investing Club with Jim Cramer, a suite of CNBC mobile apps for iOS and Android devices; Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant and Apple Siri voice interfaces. CNBC is owned by Versant Media.

Job Description:

From career growth and leadership to money, work, entrepreneurship and personal ambition, Make It helps audiences navigate the decisions that shape their professional and financial futures.

We are looking for a creative and experienced editor with sharp news judgment, excellent storytelling instincts and a deep understanding of what engages digital audiences. This editor will shape Make It’s daily and enterprise coverage, working closely with reporters, producers and senior editors to identify compelling angles, elevate story ideas and ensure every piece is clear, useful, memorable and true to the Make It voice.

The ideal candidate is both a rigorous editor and an imaginative thinker — someone who can sharpen a reported piece, improve structure and flow, craft irresistible headlines and leads, and help develop smart editorial franchises that connect with ambitious readers. They should be energized by stories about careers, success, leadership, money, work culture and the changing ways people define achievement.

This role requires a decisive editor who can weigh analytics alongside audience and departmental needs. An ideal candidate will inspire the team to do their best work, while balancing the need for speed, accuracy and creativity in a fast-moving digital newsroom. The editor will monitor the news cycle, spot emerging trends, steer coverage, and collaborate across editorial and audience teams to produce journalism that is timely, engaging and often service-driven.

Successful candidates will bring strong editorial judgment, high standards, collaborative energy and a passion for helping Make It’s audience learn, grow and get ahead.

This role is based in Englewood Cliffs, NJ and reports to CNBC’s Deputy Managing Editor for Money & Success.

At CNBC Headquarters in Englewood Cliffs, NJ, you’ll have access to great perks and amenities:

Don’t have a car? No problem! We offer free shuttle transportation to and from multiple locations in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Hoboken and Jersey City

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Salary range: $150,000-$200,000

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong understanding of SEO, analytics, digital news production and journalistic standards.
  • Proven ability to make complex topics accessible and engaging for a broad audience.

  • Experience editing short and long form with accuracy, readability, structure, tone and legal standards in mind.
  • Demonstrated ability to work quickly and effectively under deadline pressure.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Media training and experience as an expert on live television is a plus.

Desired Characteristics:

title: QoS Specialist - Telecom & Networking
description:
QoS Specialist — Telecom & Networking
Remote (Turkey) · Full-time, Employee · Operations

About Azurreo
Azurreo is the telecommunications and technology arm of Seelon Holdings, a privately held international investment group operating across four continents. We are a global leader in telecom network performance testing, measuring quality of service (QoS) and quality of experience (QoE) for operators worldwide. Trusted by major operators and technology vendors, our teams deliver advanced telecom engineering and monitoring that keep networks fast, reliable and secure. Our testing platform, SignalVerify, operates in over 144 countries, and our work spans more than 25 countries with over 250 projects delivered.

Our vision is to make every network — and every experience on it — faster, more reliable and more secure, for operators and the people they serve. Guided by Seelon Holdings' values of trust, performance and long-term partnership, we create lasting value for our clients, our people and our communities.

About the Role
As a QoS Specialist, you'll monitor service quality, analyse QoS performance, troubleshoot customer issues, and coordinate with internal technical teams through to resolution. You'll be a technical point of contact for customers — clear communication and steady service standards through the whole incident lifecycle. You'll work within an international, remote Operations team, with direct access to engineers and real influence over how the function is built as it grows.

Tasks

What you'll do

  • Monitor and analyse QoS KPIs — packet loss, latency, jitter, throughput, availability.
  • Investigate service degradation and perform first-level technical troubleshooting.
  • Manage customer incidents from report to resolution, inside SLA.
  • Coordinate with Engineering and Operations to resolve technical issues.
  • Give customers clear, professional updates throughout an incident.
  • Prepare incident reports, QoS reports and technical documentation.
  • Spot recurring issues and feed them into service improvement.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, IT, Engineering or related field.
  • 3–5 years in QoS, Service Assurance, Telecom Technical Support, Network Operations or similar (5 years preferred).
  • Solid grip on QoS KPIs, TCP/IP networking, DNS and root-cause analysis.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities independently, remotely.

Benefits

What we offer

  • Salary in EUR
  • 9 AM–6 PM local time, Monday to Friday, one-hour break.
  • Company laptop and professional tools.
  • Structured onboarding, technical training and mentorship.
  • Career growth and performance-based salary reviews.
  • Paid leave, public holidays, and fully compensated overtime when required.

Ready to apply?

Send us your CV and a short cover letter telling us about your QoS or technical support experience and what draws you to Azurreo. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview with HR, followed by a technical test, an interview with our Hiring Manager.

Azurreo is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

title: DCF Central Fulfilment Leader
description:
DCF Central Fulfilment Leader

Are you an experienced operations leader with a passion for building high-performing global fulfillment organizations, driving standardization, and improving operational efficiency across diverse geographies?

Do you enjoy collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen supply chain execution, maximize asset reliability, and support business growth through disciplined operational governance and continuous improvement?

Partnering with the best

Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company serving customers in more than 120 countries. We design, manufacture, and deliver industry-leading solutions that support energy extraction, production, and processing. Our commitment to innovation and operational excellence drives safer, cleaner, and more efficient energy solutions worldwide.

Fueling Your Passion

The Drilling & Completion Fluids Central Fulfillment Leader is accountable for the global operational strategy, governance, and execution of DCF Central Fulfillment activities across Liquid Mud Plants (LMPs), Fluid Environmental Services (FES), Asset Management, Assembly Maintenance & Overhaul (AMO), and operational systems deployment.

The successful candidate will serve as the partner to DCF leadership, Commercial, Technology, and Product Management teams on infrastructure and assets required to deliver flawless service to our customers.

This role requires strong global leadership, operational discipline, financial acumen, and the ability to drive standardization and execution across a geographically dispersed operating footprint.

The successful candidate must be capable of operating as the single point of accountability for DCF Central Fulfillment performance globally, ensuring strong governance, standardization, and execution across manufacturing, tolling, LMPs, AMO, FES, asset management, and operational systems.

This leader will bring the operational depth, business judgment, and execution discipline required to support DCF growth, improve global fulfillment reliability, strengthen working capital performance, and deliver measurable contribution to Baker Hughes’ profitability.

As a DCF Central Fulfilment Leader , you will be responsible for:

Global Operational Excellence

  • Leading global infrastructure and capex strategy for DCF LMP, AMO, FES, and associated fulfillment operations.
  • Driving consistent execution across regions to improve HSE, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and customer fulfillment.
  • Ensuring infrastructure operational readiness to support customer campaigns, regional growth, project startups, and business expansion.

Liquid Mud Plants, AMO & FES Asset Performance

  • Establishing and govern global operating standards, KPIs, rhythms, and performance management processes.
  • Establishing standard operating models for LMPs, AMO workshops, and FES operations across regions.
  • Partnering with regional service delivery teams to improve reliability, operating efficiency, and execution discipline.
  • Providing global oversight for Liquid Mud Plants, AMO locations, FES assets, and related operational infrastructure.
  • Managing asset deployment, utilization, lifecycle management, maintenance performance, and operational uptime.
  • Driving productivity, reliability, capacity utilization, and cost improvement across the global DCF asset base.
  • Supporting regional teams in resolving operational constraints impacting customer delivery and asset readiness.

To be successful in this role you will:

Education

  • Have Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Chemistry, Business, Logistics, or related technical discipline.
  • Have MBA, Master’s degree, or advanced qualification in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or Business preferred.
  • Have Lean Six Sigma, APICS, PMP, or relevant operational excellence certification preferred.

Experience

  • Have minimum 12 years of progressive experience in supply chain, manufacturing, fulfillment, operations, asset management, or service delivery.

title: Network and Firewall Analyst (Senior Infrastructure Analyst)
description:

The Enterprise Network Services team within the Information Technology directorate is seeking a high-performing individual to join the team as a Senior Infrastructure Analyst.

  • Direct or coordinate analysis and resolution of network hardware, software and wiring problems.
  • Supervise or perform network server administration and direct formulation of related procedures.
  • Monitor network performance and capacity and recommend modifications or enhancements.
  • Participate in network design including developing proposals for implementation of network components.
  • Review submitted RFCs and other change configurations for accuracy, feasibility, and implementation concerns within the Enterprise network architecture.
  • Create, maintain, and sustain accurate and standardized network site diagrams that include all managed devices, active network interfaces, IP addresses, subnet masks, and attached circuits with purchased bandwidth rates.
  • Prepare procedures, documentation and activity reports.
  • Provide input into budget and monitor expenditures.

  • Bachelor's degree in a computer related field or equivalent with at least 5 years of related experience.
  • Strong awareness of technical principles, theories, standards, practices and procedures to include the OSI Model and networking protocols.
  • Exhibit advanced end-to-end troubleshooting skills for system, network or application and identify modifications needed in existing applications to meet changing user requirements.
  • Configure and install various network devices and services (e.g., routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, wi-fi access points).

  • Learn and comply with validation requirements, standard-operating procedures (SOP), and change control maintenance for product life cycle.
  • Provide support to Data Center environments including disaster recovery and backup technologies. Preferred candidate with demonstrated experience in each.
  • Monitor system performance, resource utilization, trending, and capacity planning.
  • Assists in the creation and implementation of the strategic vision and purpose of IT systems according to the organization’s goals, objectives, and needs.
  • Ensures the consistent and effective implementation of new or changed IT services, architectures, technology, processes, information and metrics.
  • Responsible for documenting installation and maintenance processes, capacity planning, test plans, training requirements, and procurement of new IT systems.
  • Perform within change control and ticketing system environment.
  • Cisco CCNA or CCNP, Extreme Networks, and Palo Alto certifications highly preferred.
  • Good oral and written communication skills.
  • Candidate must be a team player with good customer service skills.
  • The primary work location will be Mercury, Nevada.

title: Over the Road Driver (Extraboard - Fully Endorsed)
description:
Job Summary:

As a leading LTL freight carrier who has been in business since 1931, Estes takes great pride in offering drivers in-cab ergonomics and technology that focuses on driver comfort, in alignment with the Electronic Logging Device (ELD) requirements. Estes drivers earn competitive pay and benefits such as company-provided uniforms, paid lodging, cell phone reimbursements and bonus eligibility. With an exceptional support team every mile of the way, Line Haul Extraboard Drivers are over the road away from the home domicile for an average for 5 days between home time moving freight between terminals within the Estes network. If you're looking for a rewarding and challenging career with opportunity for advancement, Estes is the place for you.

  • Will be required to operate all types of equipment to perform all safety functions, including, but not limited to, operating manual transmission, chaining tires, etc. and must be skilled and qualified to drive in all types of terrain, routes and environmental conditions.

title: Founding Office & Workplace Operations
description:
A Foundational Company

Rilla is on a mission to index the offline world.

Today, we've built the leading sales coaching software for organizations doing sales offline. We have over 1000 customers, including The Home Depot, KKR, Neighborly, and PulteGroup, using our product to enable AI sales coaching across their organization.

We are backed by Google Ventures, Bessemer Ventures, Crew Capital, and Broom Ventures, along with others.

We're an in-office team in NYC with builders who operate like high-speed reinforcement learners. We obsess over our customers, move at a high velocity, are not afraid of failure, and look to maximize our real-world impact.

The Role

As Rilla scales, the office is the engine everything else runs on, and right now there's no one who owns it end to end. This is a founding role to build it.

You'll own the physical space, the daily experience of being in the office, and the systems that get new people productive from day one.

Today this work is scattered and manual. Your job is to turn office and workplace operations into a system that runs itself — so a team of builders working ~60 hours a week in person never has to think about whether the space, the food, the supplies, or the onboarding "just works."

It does, because you built it that way.

We're looking for someone who reaches for AI and automation before the manual grind, treats logistics as a system to engineer, and takes extreme ownership of a space and a team's daily experience.

You'll sit on our BizOps team and work across HR, finance, engineering, and leadership, the connective tissue that keeps everyone moving fast.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day office operations end-to-end.

  • Manage vendor relationships — food & beverage, cleaning, facilities, building management and hold them accountable to timelines and quality

  • Keep the office stocked: order and restock supplies, snacks, drinks, and equipment before anyone notices they're low

  • Plan and run internal events, team offsites, celebrations, and the moments that build culture in a high-intensity in-office team

  • Own office-related budgets, expenses, and reconciliations, and find ways to spend smarter as we scale

  • Build the systems, checklists, and automations that make all of the above continuous instead of a scramble

  • Be the go-to person for anything space-, supply-, or experience-related, and the first line for keeping the office a place people want to be

Who You Are

  • A customer obsessive. Someone who deeply cares about delighting clients and solving their pains, not about vanity metrics.

  • An infinite learner. You are always looking to learn more and learn faster. You feel uneasy when you get complacent, and you’re constantly seeking discomfort.

  • A team player. You love giving and receiving feedback and learning and growing as a team.

  • Unafraid of failure. You take risks. You see failure as an opportunity to learn, grow, and be better the next time. In a weird way, you trick your brain into being excited when you fail because it means you get a new opportunity to learn more.

  • Affinity for the unconventional. You get a kick out of rejecting conventional wisdom. And you’re not afraid to try weird, crazy, and quite possibly stupid ideas.

  • Extremely focused. You practice extreme focus in everything you do. You’re always looking to prioritize your time and resources for maximum efficiency.

What We Require

  • 1–2 years in office management, workplace experience, administrative operations, or a similar role — startup or high-growth experience strongly preferred

  • A track record of owning a space or program end to end with minimal oversight

  • Genuine fluency with AI tools, and a bias for using them to automate real work

  • Excellent written and verbal communication across every level of the org

  • Strong organization and judgment, with comfort shipping in ambiguity and driving clarity

  • Willingness to be in the NYC office full time — this role lives in the space it runs

Nice to Have

  • Experience standing up office or workplace systems for a growing team from scratch

  • Experience owning onboarding/offboarding logistics or IT/device coordination

  • Experience managing vendors and office budgets

Prior experience owning all of this is a plus, not a hard requirement. If you're a fast learner who's hungry to own this from the ground up, we want to hear from you.

Don't Work Here

Please don't join if you're not excited about:

  1. Building the office and workplace systems for a company scaling faster than most

  2. Reaching for AI and automation before you reach for a spreadsheet

  3. Working ~60 hrs/week in person with some of the most ambitious people in NYC

  4. Attempting to build a generational company, and the intensity required to do so

Compensation & Benefits

  • Compensation: $90,000 – $120,000/year + equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Breakfast, lunch, dinner, and supplementary food and drink

  • Wellness / Gym Benefits

  • Commuter benefits

  • Relocation assistance

  • Take what you need paid time off, not accrual-based

  • $1,000 stipend for learning and personal growth

  • $1,500/month rent stipend

  • Tech equipment

title: Success Coach Supervisor
description:
Title:
Success Coach supervisor

Full-Time Position

Status:
Non-Exempt

Supervisor: Squirrel Hill Food Pantry Director

JFCS Pittsburgh

Since 1937, JFCS Pittsburgh has been pushing what’s possible in human services—combining compassion, innovation, and a relentless commitment to dignity and justice. We partner with people across the region to navigate life’s changes and challenges, ensuring that no neighbor has to navigate these difficulties alone.

We proudly serve job seekers, refugees and immigrants, individuals with disabilities, people experiencing food insecurity, those seeking mental health support, youth, and older adults. Through meaningful support and compassionate care, our goal is to help every person feel valued, empowered, and able to reach their full potential.

At JFCS, your work matters. You’ll join a team of passionate problem‑solvers and strategic thinkers who care deeply about people and aren’t afraid to rethink the way support is delivered. Here, creativity is encouraged, compassion drives every decision, and your impact is felt immediately in the community.

If you want your work to spark purpose, connection, and meaningful change—JFCS is where you can make it happen.

Position Summary

The Success Coach Supervisor provides leadership, supervision, and program oversight for a team of Success Coaches supporting adults working toward economic stability and mobility. This role ensures high-quality, strength-based service delivery grounded in human services frameworks considering environmental and structural inequities, the social determinants of health, fidelity to program models, and consistent outcomes across communities.

This position will also be responsible for maintaining Success Coach fidelity to JFCS’s Catalyst for Economic Mobility initiative. Participants in JFCS career preparation and support programs who meet program eligibility requirements may receive a stipend for up to 18 months through the Catalyst for Economic Mobility. This stipend will allow them to achieve greater financial stability as they build toward the future. Success Coaches will guide participants enrolled in the Catalyst for Economic Mobility through “light touch” support and barrier reduction in addition to support with goal setting and resource navigation.

The Supervisor supports staff not by directing every step, but by creating the conditions for strong practice through reflective supervision, skill-building, quality monitoring, and thoughtful problem-solving. This position balances clinical oversight, staff development, and operational accountability while centering dignity, client ownership, and long-term impact.

Duties and Responsibilities

Staff Supervision & Development

  • Collaborate with Directors and staff members both internally and from other organizations to ensure that referral information is complete, enabling a clear understanding of client needs and urgency, and to assign clients to Success Coaches.
  • Provide regular individual and group supervision to Success Coach, emphasizing reflective practice, ensuring that direct reports incorporate clients’ specific circumstances into the development of targeted strategies, and use strengths-based approaches to guide client interactions.
  • Support staff in identifying challenges and opportunities to help clients achieve their goals.
  • Monitor staff workload, caseload balance, and performance to ensure sustainability and quality.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, training, and ongoing professional development of coaching staff.
  • Foster a supportive, inclusive team culture grounded in learning, accountability, and respect.

Program Quality & Fidelity

  • Ensure the program is delivered consistently across communities and aligned with the established human services and economic mobility framework.
  • Monitor fidelity to core program components, including intake, service plans, client ownership of action steps, and referral practices.
  • Review case notes, service plans and documentation for quality, completeness, and adherence to program standards.
  • Identify variations in quality or adherence across staff and provide targeted coaching or corrective support as needed.
  • Support thoughtful adaptations that respond to client needs while preserving core program principles.

Client Services Oversight

  • Provide consultation and guidance on complex client situations, barriers, and system navigation challenges.
  • Support direct reports in maintaining healthy boundaries to prevent burnout and ensure that Success Coaches develop relationships with clients that promote self-reliance rather than dependency.
  • Support staff in making effective warm referrals and maintaining strong relationships with community partners.
  • Ensure services remain client-centered, culturally responsive, and grounded in dignity and respect.
  • Step in to support direct service delivery as needed during high-demand periods or staffing gaps.

Training & Capacity Building

  • Support staff participation in the development of coaching skills, motivational interviewing, and strength-based models.
  • Reinforce learning through supervision, observation, and feedback.
  • Identify training needs based on program data, staff feedback, and observed practice trends.
  • Maintain knowledge and understanding of the most pertinent and up-to-date resources and systems for which clients may need referrals
  • Promote continuous learning and reflective practice across the team.

Documentation, Data & Compliance

  • Ensure timely, accurate, and consistent documentation in the program’s case management system (Apricot).
  • Monitor data quality to support outcome tracking, reporting, and funder compliance. Generate program reports for funders and external communications and requests for data.
  • Collaborate with leadership to review program outcomes and identify areas for improvement.
  • Ensure compliance with ethical standards, confidentiality requirements, data privacy regulations, and mandatory reporting laws.

Collaboration & Leadership

  • Serve as a liaison between frontline staff and program leadership.
  • Contribute to program planning, improvement efforts, and cross-department collaboration.
  • Build and maintain relationships with community partners to strengthen referral pathways and service coordination.
  • Collaborate with JFCS Development staff to generate program reports and respond to data requests for funders and grant proposals

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in social work, education, or related field, Master’s degree preferred
  • Strong administration, management, training, and organization skills. - Minimum 3 years of experience with case management, service coordination and a program monitoring background.
  • Experience with quality assurance reports.
  • Substantial ability to effectively interact with people of various cultural backgrounds and ability to respond appropriately to the cultural characteristics of the clients. - Excellent team player with organizational and communication skills.
  • Willingness to work in the field, car, and ability to maintain PA driver’s license and auto insurance required.
  • Strong computer skills, particularly Word and Excel required; prior experience using data and tracking systems is strongly preferred.

At Evergreen Trading, we’re driven by collaboration and value creation for our clients. That’s why we’re the go-to, strategic partner for marquee brands across industries. Since our founding in 2009, Evergreen Trading has always believed that our people are the most valuable part of our business. That’s why our company is 100% employee owned. Evergreen Trading is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply and believe diversity enhances our creativity, innovation, and overall success.
